title: High Ticket Sales Closer: Premium AI Systems for US Businesses (Remote, Base Up to $2,000/mo + Commission)
description:
I’m Ian Flynn, founder of IRF LLC in Wisconsin. I build and run AI and automation systems for small businesses. I’m hiring one experienced sales closer who can find the buyer, run the sales conversation, and get the deal paid.



I build custom workflows, integrations, and tools that collect data and feed it into a CRM. I set up and repair GoHighLevel accounts, connect lead forms and calendars, and automate follow up by text and
. I also build websites, set up social workflows and
 domains, and write guides so the team can run what we build. My team and I handle the technical work, test it, and support the client after delivery.



What you’ll sell



Start with a real business problem. If a company is losing calls, discuss an AI receptionist and booking workflow. If leads fall through the cracks, discuss GoHighLevel setup or repair, follow up by text and
, or a website that sends inquiries into the CRM. You can also sell custom integrations, data collection and reporting, or a dedicated worker computer when it fits the scope.



What you’ll own



Choose the businesses you want to approach and find your own prospects. Run outreach, discovery, and sales calls. Learn what the problem costs the buyer, present the right option using our confirmed pricing, handle objections, and follow the deal through our invoice and payment. Bring me in when technical scope or a quote needs confirmation. Once the client is signed, hand off the agreed scope and I’ll take it from there.



You’ll get the portfolio, confirmed pricing, and technical help on qualified opportunities. The work is judged on your ability to move real deals forward. Agree on scope, pricing, and timing with me before promising them to a buyer.



Portfolio: 



Pay and hours



This is a remote role, 10 hours per week. The trial base is $100 USD per month from day one. Your base rises to $1,500 to $2,000 USD per month after the first deal or two, plus commission.



The first sale pays 60% commission. After that, commission is 35% on one time sales and 25% on recurring sales. Commission is calculated on cleared payments.



How to apply



Tell me about one paid deal you closed yourself. What type of buyer was it, what did you sell, what did they pay, and how did you find them? Tell me which parts of the sale you handled personally. Leave out the customer’s name and any private details.



Then tell me which of our offers you’d start with, who you’d sell it to, and where you’d find your first five prospects.

I’m Ian Flynn, founder of IRF LLC in Wisconsin. I build and run AI and automation systems for small businesses. I’m hiring one experienced sales closer who can find the buyer, run the sales conversation, and get the deal paid.



I build custom workflows, integrations, and tools that collect data and feed it into a CRM. I set up and repair GoHighLevel accounts, connect lead forms and calendars, and automate follow up by text and
. I also build websites, set up social workflows and
 domains, and write guides so the team can run what we build. My team and I handle the technical work, test it, and support the client after delivery.



What you’ll sell



Start with dedicated worker computers for businesses that want background work off their main laptops. I can repurpose suitable Macs with Linux, set them up for remote access, and configure them to run jobs such as data processing, reporting, and workflow automation. Where it fits the client, you can also sell AI receptionists, GoHighLevel setup and repair, websites, or custom integrations.



What you’ll own



Choose the businesses you want to approach and find your own prospects. Run outreach, discovery, and sales calls. Learn what the problem costs the buyer, present the right option using our confirmed pricing, handle objections, and follow the deal through our invoice and payment. Bring me in when technical scope or a quote needs confirmation. Once the client is signed, hand off the agreed scope and I’ll take it from there.



You’ll get the portfolio, confirmed pricing, and technical help on qualified opportunities. The work is judged on your ability to move real deals forward. Agree on scope, pricing, and timing with me before promising them to a buyer.



Portfolio: 



Pay and hours



This is a remote role, 10 hours per week. The trial base is $100 USD per month from day one. Your base rises to $1,500 to $2,000 USD per month after the first deal or two, plus commission.



We’ll review the existing commission terms on the first call.



How to apply



Tell me about one paid deal you closed yourself. What type of buyer was it, what did you sell, what did they pay, and how did you find them? Tell me which parts of the sale you handled personally. Leave out the customer’s name and any private details.



Then tell me which of our offers you’d start with, who you’d sell it to, and where you’d find your first five prospects.

title: Social Media Manager & Brand Growth Strategist
description:
SUMMARY



We are looking for a creative and experienced Social Media Manager to manage the social media presence of two established Australian businesses in the pet care industry.



The ideal candidate is skilled in creating engaging Reels, editing short-form videos, designing social media content and developing strategies to grow business accounts.



We want someone who understands social media trends, has a strong creative eye and can independently manage content from planning to publishing.



RESPONSIBILITIES



Edit engaging short-form videos and Instagram Reels.



Create social media graphics, carousels and posts.



Plan, schedule and publish content on Instagram and
.



Write engaging captions and creative copy.



Research trending audio and content ideas.



Develop strategies to grow both business accounts.



Manage comments, messages and community engagement.



Monitor performance and provide regular reports.



REQUIREMENTS



Proven experience in social media management and content creation.



Strong Reels and short-form video editing skills.



Excellent portfolio showcasing previous work.



Experience growing business social media accounts.



Knowledge of current social media trends.



Excellent written English.



Creative, organised and able to work independently.



Nice to have: Experience in pet care, veterinary businesses or Meta Ads.



APPLICATION QUESTIONS



How many years of experience do you have in social media management and content creation?



What video editing tools do you use?



Can you share your portfolio and examples of Reels or videos you have created?



Have you managed business social media accounts and achieved measurable growth? Briefly describe your experience.



Have you worked with pet-related businesses?



HOW TO APPLY



Please

Subject: CAT SMM – Your Full Name



WhatsApp: Include your WhatsApp number for faster communication.



Important: A strong portfolio showcasing your video editing and content creation skills is essential. Applications without relevant work samples may not be considered.

title: Cold Caller / Real Estate Prospector
description:
Cold Caller / Real Estate Prospector

Remote | Full-Time | Cash Home Buying Company



***About the Role

We are looking for a confident, persistent, and results-driven Cold Caller / Real Estate Prospector to join our growing team.

In this role, you will be responsible for reaching out to property owners, identifying potential sellers, building rapport, and generating qualified leads for our acquisitions team.

You will play an important role in the company's lead generation efforts by turning cold prospects into meaningful conversations and potential real estate opportunities.

The ideal candidate is comfortable making high-volume outbound calls, can think on their feet, and knows how to engage people naturally without sounding overly scripted or pushy."



***Key Responsibilities

Outbound Calling & Prospecting

Make high-volume outbound calls to property owners using provided lead lists and dialing systems.

Introduce the company's cash home-buying services and generate interest from potential sellers.

Engage property owners in meaningful conversations to understand their selling intentions.

Consistently work through assigned prospecting lists and meet daily calling targets.



***Lead Qualification

Identify motivated sellers and assess their interest in selling their properties.

Ask relevant questions to understand property conditions, ownership, selling timelines, and reasons for selling.

Identify potential opportunities and determine whether prospects meet the company's qualification criteria.

Schedule qualified appointments or transfer promising leads to the acquisitions team.

Relationship Building

Establish rapport and maintain a friendly, professional, and conversational approach.

Handle objections confidently while remaining respectful and persistent.

Recognize buying signals and identify opportunities to move prospects further along the sales pipeline.

Maintain a positive and professional impression of the company during every interaction.



***CRM & Reporting

Accurately document call outcomes, prospect information, and relevant conversation notes in the CRM.

Update lead statuses and schedule appropriate follow-ups.

Maintain organized records to ensure no potential opportunity is overlooked.

Communicate progress, challenges, and lead insights to the team through designated messaging channels.

Must-Have Qualities

Excellent verbal English communication skills and a confident phone presence.

Comfortable making frequent outbound calls and speaking with unfamiliar people.

Strong persuasion, rapport-building, and objection-handling skills.

Persistent and resilient, especially when dealing with unanswered calls or rejected offers.

Ability to think quickly and adapt conversations based on prospect responses.

Self-motivated, disciplined, and capable of working independently in a remote environment.

Strong listening skills and the ability to identify potential sales opportunities.

Detail-oriented when documenting conversations and updating CRM records.



***Preferred Experience

Previous experience in cold calling, telemarketing, outbound sales, appointment setting, or lead generation.

Experience in real estate prospecting, wholesaling, or property-related sales is a strong advantage.

Familiarity with CRM platforms, particularly Podio.

Experience using auto-dialers or power dialers such as BatchDialer.

Ability to work with Microsoft Office and team communication tools.

Don't have real estate experience? That's okay! Full training on the company's processes, scripts, tools, and workflows will be provided. We value a strong work ethic, coachability, and willingness to learn.



***Tools You'll Use

CRM: Podio

Auto-Dialer: BatchDialer or similar power dialing platforms

Communication: Slack

Productivity: Microsoft Office (Outlook, Word, and Excel)



***How Success Is Measured

Daily Call Volume: Consistently meeting assigned outbound calling targets.

Lead Generation: Number of potential sellers successfully engaged.

Lead Qualification: Quality and quantity of qualified prospects generated.

Appointment Setting: Number of qualified appointments or opportunities passed to the acquisitions team.

CRM Accuracy: Complete and accurate documentation of calls and prospect information.

Consistency: Maintaining productivity, follow-up schedules, and overall prospecting performance.



***How to Apply

To be considered for this position, please include the following in your application:

1. Written Response: Answer the question below

"Tell us about a time you had to make repeated attempts or overcome rejection to achieve a goal. How did you handle the situation, and what was the outcome?"

2. Updated CV/Resume: Attach your latest resume in PDF format.

3. Video Introduction: Submit a fresh 1–2 minute video introduction recorded specifically for this role. Please share your recording through a Vocaroo link.

title: Logistics Truckload Operations and Carrier Sales Specialist
description:
Required qualifications



•At least two years of hands-on U.S. truckload brokerage or carrier-sales experience, including direct carrier negotiation and load booking. Three or more years and direct customer responsibility are strongly preferred.

•Demonstrated ability to interpret freight market data and explain an actual purchasing decision using lane conditions, carrier availability, and service requirements.

•Clear, confident spoken English and professional written English, with experience handling difficult customer and carrier conversations.

•Working knowledge of U.S. freight geography, truckload equipment, appointment requirements, carrier qualification, and common accessorial charges.

•Practical experience with DAT and/or Truckstop, a transportation management system, spreadsheets, business
, and phone tools.

•Ability to work the agreed U.S. Eastern schedule, with reliable computer equipment, a headset, a quiet workspace, backup internet, and a power contingency plan.



Preferred experience

Flatbed or expedited freight; recurring-lane carrier development; brokerage carrier-verification systems; and experience supporting a U.S. brokerage agent. Specific software can be learned; sound freight judgment and clear communication must be demonstrated.





Role overview

We are looking for an experienced freight operations professional to book reliable trucks, make informed purchasing decisions, and communicate confidently with U.S. customers and carriers. You will own assigned truckload shipments from planning through delivery, protect customer relationships when problems arise, and balance service commitments with carrier cost and company margin.



The core workload is U.S. truckload brokerage. Dry van experience is essential; flatbed and expedited experience are valuable. The exact shift and any separately agreed after-hours coverage will be confirmed before hiring.



Carrier sourcing and booking

•Review each shipment’s equipment, commodity, weight, dimensions, pickup and delivery appointments, and special handling needs before sourcing capacity.

•Source qualified trucks through existing carrier relationships, outbound calls, DAT, Truckstop, and other company-approved tools. Negotiate competitive carrier rates and confirm capacity.

•Verify carrier approval, identity, authority, insurance, and service history using company procedures. Escalate unresolved qualification or fraud concerns before booking.

•Confirm the truck’s location, availability, appointment feasibility, and dispatch details with the carrier. Issue accurate rate confirmations and document agreed charges.

•Build dependable carrier relationships on recurring lanes and maintain alternatives for difficult or time-sensitive shipments.

Market informed purchasing

•Use relevant broker-to-carrier spot-rate data, recent internal purchases, and live carrier quotes to recommend a realistic buy range for each load.

•Evaluate equipment type, lane and market geography, data freshness, capacity, seasonality, deadhead, lead time, and appointment constraints. Explain how these factors affect the booking decision.

•Compare equivalent prices by separating linehaul, fuel, and accessorials. Calculate expected gross profit and margin accurately.

•Book within agreed purchasing authority. When service needs or market conditions exceed the approved range, present the options, cost impact, and recommended action promptly.



Customer communication and shipment ownership

•Monitor assigned loads from dispatch through delivery, maintain accurate ETAs, and keep customers and internal teammates informed before they need to request an update.

•Handle late arrivals, missed appointments, carrier cancellations, breakdowns, detention, layover, and delivery exceptions calmly and professionally by phone and
.

•When a shipment is at risk, communicate verified facts, the likely impact, available recovery options, and the next update time. Avoid promising unconfirmed ETAs or solutions.

•Coordinate replacement capacity, appointment changes, and other recovery actions within approved limits. Escalate material cost increases, claims, service concessions, and unresolved risks with a clear recommendation.

•Keep TMS milestones, carrier contacts, shipment notes, rate confirmations, and BOL/POD records current. Document extra charges and support accurate billing.

•Maintain ownership until resolution and provide a clear handoff for any active issue extending beyond scheduled coverage.



How to apply

Share a link of your resume, your relevant U.S. freight experience, the tools and equipment types you know, typical weekly load volume, and expected compensation. Include a brief example of a shipment problem you personally resolved. Shortlisted candidates will complete a practical booking exercise and a customer-call role-play.

title: AI Systems Architect
description:
Remote · Full-time · Eastern Time Schedule . ₱100,000–₱115,000/month depending on experience + HMO + 10 days paid leave after 6 months,



About the role:



We're looking for a hands-on AI Systems Architect to design, build and run the AI foundation our whole organization will work on.



You'll shape how our teams and clients use AI agents day to day, so people spend less time on repetitive work and more time on work that matters. This is a build role, not an advisory one. You'll write production code, make the architecture calls and set the standards others build on.

If you enjoy turning messy business workflows into reliable, secure AI systems, and you care whether they actually make people's work better, we'd like to hear from you.



What you'll do:



• Design our AI architecture. Set the standards for models, agents, orchestration, memory, tools, data access and human review.

• Build AI agents that work in production. Create agents, multi-agent systems and reusable services that teams can rely on.

• D
 what AI should and shouldn't do. Choose when work belongs to an AI agent, regular software, an automated workflow or a person.

• Set up how people work with agents. Define each agent's job, tools, permissions and escalation rules, and how people assign, review and accept its work.

• Keep things secure across clients. Design a multi-client setup that keeps each client's data separate and protects confidential information.

• Measure quality. Build evaluation and testing that tracks accuracy, reliability, cost, speed and rework, and catches hallucinations and bad recommendations.

• Guard against AI-specific risks. Handle prompt injection, data leakage and unauthorized tool use, with clear audit trails and human approval where it counts.

• Turn business needs into working systems. Translate requirements into workflows, integrations and clear acceptance criteria.

• Lead and coach developers. Give direction, review work and help others build with the patterns you set.

• Solve the hard problems yourself. Stay close enough to the code to understand real effort and risk.



What you'll bring:



•5+ years of professional software engineering, including at least 2 years building AI/LLM systems used by real users or clients

• A track record of building AI agents or multi-agent systems

• Strong hands-on software engineering skills and experience with enterprise or platform architecture

• Practical experience with LLMs, structured outputs, tool calling, retrieval and orchestration

• Experience connecting AI systems to applications, databases, knowledge sources and APIs

• Experience building evaluation, testing and quality checks for AI

• Experience with authentication, permissions, audit logging and data protection

• Experience deploying, monitoring and supporting AI systems in production

• A history of turning business workflows into secure technical solutions and leading delivery

• Evidence that your work produced measurable improvements in operations, productivity or revenue

We don't require any particular framework, model provider or vendor. We care that you choose tools based on security, reliability, cost and business need.



Nice to have:



• A degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, AI, Data Science or a related field, or equivalent professional experience

• Experience with multi-client or multi-tenant platforms

• Experience building reusable AI products or platform capabilities

• Experience with knowledge architecture, semantic systems or advanced retrieval

• Experience in a growing company where systems and standards are still taking shape



How you work:



• You think in systems and enjoy rolling up your sleeves to solve problems.

• You're open about your assumptions and blind spots, and you make uncertainty visible.

• You're comfortable making progress with incomplete information.

• You explain technical ideas clearly to both engineers and non-technical colleagues.

• You take security, evidence, quality and human accountability seriously.

• You challenge assumptions constructively, including knowing when AI isn't the right answer.

• You care about outcomes, not just activity.

• You build systems others can use without needing you in the loop.



What success looks like:



• A secure, reusable AI architecture is in place and well understood.

• AI agents do approved work reliably, within clear permissions.

• Everyone knows what AI handles, what people review and when to escalate.

• Teams produce more useful work with less repetition and rework.

• AI costs, risks and performance are visible and under control.

• Developers deliver AI features faster using the patterns you set.

• Our AI capabilities deliver measurable benefits for the business and our clients.



How to apply

Send your CV and a short note about an AI system you built and the results it delivered.

title: Sales & Operations VA — US Residential Cleaning Company (BookingKoala + GoHighLevel) — Full-Time, Long-Term — EXPERIENCE
description:

A growing US residential cleaning company is hiring ONE full-time Virtual Assistant to run sales, support, and scheduling operations: quoting and closing new bookings, taking care of booked customers, keeping the daily cleaning schedule fully assigned, and coordinating with our cleaning teams.



Company details are shared with shortlisted candidates. What matters for this post is the work, the standards, and the fit.



This role sells AND runs operations. You will quote, follow up, and close bookings — and keep the daily schedule fully assigned. If you love talking to customers, following up until you get the yes, and making sure nothing falls through the cracks, this is for you.



Most important responsibilities:

1. Daily scheduling board — Own today and tomorrow: every clean confirmed, assigned, and checked the day before. Assign cleaners closest-first, based on the cleaner's home area and their other jobs that day. Zero unassigned cleans going into tomorrow is your number.

2. Booked-customer support — Answer and return calls and texts quickly and professionally. Handle reschedules, day-of questions, and issues calmly. Resolve it fully, or escalate to the owner with a clear written summary.

3. Card-hold checks — Check the payment hold before every clean. Our rule: no hold, no cleaner. Flag any failed or missing hold to the owner the same day, never the morning of the clean.

4. Confirmations + after-clean follow-up — Back up automated confirmations where one is missing. After each clean, confirm it was completed, check the customer is happy, and ask for a review.

5. Cleaner coordination — Arrival updates, running-late messages to customers, completion confirmations, and job photos, throughout the day.

6. Recruiting support — Screen cleaner applicants against our checklist and book qualified applicants into phone interviews with the owner during set interview blocks, Eastern Time.

7. Sales: quote, follow up, close — Answer new leads fast, gather the home details, build the quote in BookingKoala, send it, follow up until they book or say no, handle questions and objections, and close the booking. Re-engage past clients and push for recurring bookings.

8. CRM discipline — Keep every conversation, change, and task updated in our systems. If it is not written down, it did not happen.



Tools we use — you must already know at least one of these well: BookingKoala, GoHighLevel, Quo/OpenPhone, Slack, Google Workspace. We train you on OUR way of working, not on the basics of the job or the software.



Requirements — do not apply without these. Experience is required, this is not an entry-level role:

- 2+ years of experience as a virtual assistant, operations coordinator, dispatcher, or scheduler

- At least 1 year supporting a cleaning company or another US home-services company (cleaning, plumbing, HVAC, moving, etc.) — you must name the type of company and how long you worked there in your application

- Sales experience with a proven record — inbound sales calls, fast lead follow-up, cold calling, and closing bookings, ideally for a cleaning or home-services company

- Hands-on experience with BookingKoala or GoHighLevel, or a directly comparable booking/CRM platform (Jobber, Housecall Pro, ZenMaid)

- Fluent spoken and written English — you will be on the phone with US homeowners and cleaning teams every day, and your writing goes directly to customers

- Extremely detail-obsessed: names, dates, times, and addresses right the first time, every time

- Calm under pressure: call-outs, reschedules, and declined cards can all land in the same hour

- Reliable computer, headset, quiet workspace, and a backup internet/power plan

- Available full-time during US Eastern business hours, including some weekend coverage as scheduled

- This must be your only full-time job

- Immediate availability preferred. Willing to sign a confidentiality agreement



HOW TO APPLY — FOLLOW EXACTLY. THIS IS THE MAIN FILTER:

Apply through OnlineJobs.ph with the subject line: VA Application - [Your Full Name] - Sales & Operations

Your application must include ALL of the following:

1. Your resume (PDF)

2. A 1-2 minute video (Loom, Google Drive, or YouTube unlisted — link must be viewable). Briefly introduce yourself and your most relevant experience. Then answer this scenario: "A recurring customer wants to move Tuesday's clean to Thursday, but Thursday is fully booked — and a different customer's payment hold for tomorrow just declined. Walk me through what you do, in what order, and who you contact first."

3. A screenshot of a recent internet speed test

4. One line listing every CRM, booking, and phone system you have used

5. One professional reference — name, company, and contact — preferably a cleaning or home-services manager

6. Your experience, stated plainly: the cleaning or home-services companies you have supported, how long at each, and exactly what you did there (scheduling, dispatch, customer support, cleaner coordination)



Write your application professionally, in your own words. Applications missing any item will not be reviewed. Applications with grammatical errors or unprofessional writing will not move forward. Applications that do not show the required experience will not move forward.



What happens next: Shortlisted candidates complete a short paid test task, then a final interview with the owner (behavioral questions + a live mock call), then a paid trial week. If you are not strong on the phone under pressure, this process will show it — please only apply if that is a strength.



Salary: $6-$8/hour starting out, depending on experience, with room to grow — for experienced operators only. Full-time, 40 hours/week. Paid test task and paid trial week at the same rate. Long-term only: this seat grows into an operations lead role as the team grows. We are looking for our person, not a temporary fill.

We believe in rewarding the people who show up, execute well, and grow with us and we're looking for someone who wants to be part of that from the ground floor.



We’re hiring a full-time AI Creative Strategist to analyze social media data from posted videos, understand content and marketing on a fundamental level, create raw AI clips, and assemble them into polished short-form videos using our internal workflows.



This is a strategy AND execution role. You’ll be taught from the ground up how to actually think like a creator - not just how to follow instructions.



If you haven't used every tool on our stack yet, that's okay. We care much more about having a hunger to learn, strong English, and your ability to improve independently. We'll give you the resources - what you do with them is up to you.



What You'll Do



Creative Strategy & Data

- Analyze the performance of posted videos and understand WHY certain content wins or loses

- Use data to create a feedback loop and continuously improve future videos

- Identify winning hooks, formats, angles, pacing, and creative patterns

- Research competitors, audiences, trends, and high-performing content

- Come to us with what you've learned, what you've changed, and where you need advice - not wait for us to tell you what to do 



Copywriting & Content

- Understand the fundamentals of hooks, storytelling, retention, persuasion, and customer psychology

- Write and improve short-form scripts based on research and performance data

- Identify weaknesses in scripts and creatives before production

- Develop new ideas and angles instead of simply recreating existing content

- Adapt content to different brands, audiences, and niches 



Video Editing

- Turn raw footage and AI-generated assets into high-retention short-form content

- Edit in CapCut with strong pacing, captions, B-roll, overlays, sound design, and visual storytelling

- Develop a strong creative eye and independently identify what needs improvement

- Maintain quality and consistency across multiple client accounts

- Apply feedback quickly and make sure the same mistakes don't keep happening 



AI Content Creation

- Generate AI images, videos, avatars, voices, and other creative assets using our tools

- Use tools such as ChatGPT, Grok, Veo3, and others as part of the creative process

- Experiment with new tools and workflows as AI technology evolves

- Quality check all AI outputs before using them in content

- Learn how to get better outputs instead of relying on us to provide every prompt or solution 



General

- Manage multiple projects without missing deadlines

- Communicate proactively about progress, ideas, problems, and results

- Take ownership of your work from research to final output

- Constantly look for ways to improve your own skills and the team's content

- Solve problems independently before immediately asking for help 



Requirements



Must-Haves

- EXTREMELY STRONG ENGLISH - WRITTEN, SPOKEN, AND COMPREHENSION

- GROWTH MINDSET AND GENUINE HUNGER TO LEARN!!!! 

- Experience editing short-form content - PORTFOLIO REQUIRED

- Strong WiFi connection with rare occurrences of outages

- Strong proficiency in CapCut

- Strong attention to detail and creative quality

- Able to think critically and understand WHY content performs

- Comfortable working with data and using it to improve creative decisions

- Willing to learn copywriting, marketing, AI, editing, and content strategy

- Extremely proactive - you should be coming to us with improvements, not waiting for us to find your mistakes

- Able to research and teach yourself when you don't know something

- Able to take feedback without ego and immediately apply it

- Willing to go above and beyond what is directly assigned

- Able to manage multiple projects without missing deadlines

- Reliable internet and dedicated workspace

- Currently working with NO OTHER CLIENTS. All work commitment should be on this role.



Nice-to-Haves

- Previous agency or content production experience

- Copywriting or direct-response marketing experience

- Experience analyzing social media performance data

- Strong understanding of hooks, pacing, retention, and storytelling

- Experience with AI tools such as ChatGPT, Grok, Veo3, Kling, or similar tools

- Experience researching competitors, customers, and markets

- Strong understanding of internet culture and social media trends



What We Offer

- Stable, full-time remote role with consistent workload

- Access to all required AI and editing tools

- Copywriting, marketing, editing, and creative strategy resources

- Direct feedback and mentorship on your work

- Access to real performance data so you can understand what actually works

- Freedom to test ideas, experiment, and develop your own creative instincts

- Opportunity to develop skills across editing, AI, copywriting, data analysis, and strategy

- Growth opportunities as we scale

- Performance bonuses of up to 40% of monthly pay.



How to Apply



Include all of the following. INCOMPLETE APPLICATIONS WILL NOT BE REVIEWED:

title: Virtual Assistant – Generalist (Digital Marketing Experience Only)
description:
• Location: Remote (Work from Home) / Hybrid

• Salary: ₱25,000 - ₱35,000/month DOE (Depending on Experience)

• Employment Type: Full-time

• Work Schedule: 12:00 PM – 9:00 PM (Philippine Time) or Flexible



About Sparkblaze Digital



Sparkblaze Digital is a full-service digital marketing agency dedicated to helping startups and growing

businesses ignite growth with innovative, results-driven strategies. Our team builds and manages data

driven campaigns — from paid advertising and SEO to landing pages and conversion rate optimization —

that generate measurable ROI for our clients.



We work across a wide range of industries, including e-commerce, B2B, SaaS, finance, real estate, home

services, and local businesses, helping each one scale smarter and grow faster with tailored strategies.

We are a fully remote team transitioning to a hybrid and face to face set-up, and we are looking for a

fresh, eager, and adaptable VA Generalist who is ready to learn the digital marketing business from the

ground up and support our team across a wide variety of tasks.

Here, your work does more than grow brands. Every client we serve is making the world better in some

way, from charitable causes and mold and environmental testing that protects people's health, to

organizations that donate to and uplift the youth. Start your digital marketing career with campaigns

that deliver real results and support causes that truly matter.



What You'll Do



As a VA Generalist, you will provide flexible, day-to-day support to our team and clients across a variety

of administrative, operational, and digital marketing tasks. You will start with general virtual assistant

work and gradually be trained in areas such as media buying, reporting, and campaign support. You will

be a go-to person who is willing to take on whatever the team needs.



Your responsibilities may include:

• Handling general virtual assistant tasks such as
 and inbox management, calendar

scheduling, data entry, document preparation, and file organization.

• Supporting account managers and team leads with client coordination, follow-ups, and meeting

notes.

• Assisting with research tasks such as competitor research, keyword research, audience research,

and lead list building.

• Learning and supporting paid media tasks, including campaign setup assistance, ad copy and

creative uploads, and monitoring of Google Ads and Meta Ads under the guidance of senior

media buyers.

• Helping prepare weekly and monthly performance reports using spreadsheets, dashboards, and

templates provided by the team.

• Assisting with basic tracking and tool checks (GA4, Google Tag Manager, Meta Pixel) as you are

trained.

• Supporting the creative, SEO, and web teams with content posting, basic landing page updates,

and quality checks.

• Updating project management tools and CRMs (e.g., Asana, Trello, ClickUp, HubSpot) to keep

tasks, leads, and deadlines organized.

• Helping document and follow the team's standard operating procedures (SOPs), and suggesting

improvements as you learn.

• Taking on other tasks and special projects as assigned by the team, with a positive attitude and a

willingness to learn.



What Are We Looking For?



We are looking for an adaptable, reliable, and quick-learning fresh graduate who is excited to start a

career in digital marketing. You do not need to be an expert, but you should be willing to learn new

things every day, follow instructions carefully, and take ownership of the tasks given to you in a fast

paced agency environment.



You should have:

• A completed bachelor's degree in any course (fresh graduates are strongly encouraged to apply;

no prior work experience required).

• Willingness to learn new skills such as media buying, reporting, and digital marketing tools, with

the drive to grow into more advanced roles.

• Committed and loyal team members who are looking to build a long-term career with us and

grow alongside the team.

• General knowledge of virtual assistant tasks such as
 management, scheduling, data entry,

research, and document handling.

• Basic working knowledge of Google Workspace (Gmail, Google Docs, Google Sheets, Google

Drive) and Microsoft Office tools.

• Flexibility and the ability to work on anything asked of you, from admin tasks to marketing

support, and to switch between tasks and priorities quickly.

• Good analytical and attention-to-detail skills, with the ability to organize information and spot

mistakes before they become problems.

• Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, including clear updates and

professional communication with teammates and clients.

• Comfort learning and using project management tools and CRMs (e.g., Asana, Trello, ClickUp,

HubSpot); prior exposure is a plus but not required.

• Familiarity with or curiosity about digital marketing, social media, and advertising platforms

(Google Ads, Meta Ads, LinkedIn, TikTok) is a plus.

• Willingness to work flexible hours to align with clients or team members in different time zones.

• Someone who has a stable and reliable internet connection.

• Who has a working, well-conditioned device (laptop or desktop).

• Backup devices available to ensure uninterrupted workflow in case of emergency.



Who Are We Looking For?



We are looking for A-players — individuals who are hungry, curious, and take full ownership of their

growth and their results.



• Adaptable: Open to doing anything the team needs and comfortable switching between

different types of tasks.

• Eager to Learn: Excited to pick up new skills such as media buying, reporting, and digital

marketing tools.

• Accountable: Owns wins and misses alike, and follows through without needing to be chased.

• Proactive: Anticipates needs, asks smart questions, and takes initiative rather than waiting to be

told what to do.

• Coachable: Takes feedback well and continuously improves their craft.

• Detail-Oriented: Double-checks work, follows instructions carefully, and keeps things organized.

• A Strong Communicator: Gives clear updates, asks for clarification when needed, and works well

with teammates and clients alike.

• A Team Player: Supports the team, shares the workload, and raises the standard for everyone

around them.

• Curious & Growth-Oriented: Always learning, testing, and keeping up with the latest in digital

marketing.



Why Join Sparkblaze Digital



• Hands-On Training: Learn real digital marketing skills, including paid media, reporting, and

campaign support, from experienced professionals.

• Diverse Client Portfolio: Get exposure to e-commerce, B2B, SaaS, finance, and local businesses

to broaden your skills and experience.

• Career Growth: A clear pathway to grow from VA Generalist into roles such as Junior Media

Buyer, Media Buyer, Account Coordinator, or Account Strategist.

• Supportive Environment: A skill-focused, collaborative work setup built for driven learners and

performers.



If you're a fresh graduate who's ready to learn, grow, and take on new challenges alongside a fast-paced

digital marketing team — we'd love to hear from you.



Apply now and take the first step in your digital marketing career with Sparkblaze Digital.

title: Amazon FBA Online Arbitrage Product Researcher
description:
JOB TITLE

Amazon UK Online Sourcing VA (Keepa) – Long-term Role with Commission



ABOUT THE ROLE

We are a growing Amazon UK FBA business and we are looking for a reliable, detail-focused VA to join us on a long-term basis. The main focus of the role is online arbitrage: finding products sold by UK retailers that can be resold profitably on Amazon UK. As we work together, the role will also cover wider Amazon admin, so there is real room to grow.



A basic understanding of Amazon FBA and Keepa is enough to start, and experienced candidates are very welcome too. Training is provided for anything you haven't done before, and all tools and subscriptions are supplied.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Use Keepa (Product Finder and product graphs) to identify products worth sourcing

- Assess each product's sales speed, price history, Buy Box behaviour and competition, including whether Amazon itself is selling

- Search UK retailer websites for matching products at a profitable buy price

- Verify every match carefully: barcode, size, variant, pack quantity, packaging and images

- Calculate profit and ROI, including Amazon referral and FBA fees, delivery and prep costs

- Check for discounts, voucher codes and cashback, and include them only when confirmed

- Record leads in a shared Google Sheet using a set format, with clear notes on any risks or uncertainties

- Support general Seller Central admin as the business grows such as chasing reimbursements, listing changes, repricing etc.



WHAT I'M LOOKING FOR

- At least a basic working knowledge of Amazon FBA and Keepa (Buy Box, sales rank, offer counts, price history)

- Strong attention to detail, with the ability to work accurately at a good pace

- Comfortable with Google Sheets and simple formulas

- Good written English and clear, proactive communication

- Reliable, honest and willing to flag mistakes or uncertainties

- Happy to follow a defined process and take feedback on board

- Knowledge of Amazon UK or UK retailers is a strong advantage

- Reliable internet connection and a suitable place to work



HOW WE WORK

- Clear processes and regular feedback on your work

- Quality leads that I can act on whilst utilising your speed to combine quantity and quality. 

- Regular check-ins and performance reviews

- Independent contractor role, invoiced monthly

- Confidentiality is expected

- Open to challenge and discussions to improve business performance



COMMISSION AND GROWTH

- Short term and long term commission schemes available

- Opportunity to take on more responsibility as the business grows

- Base salary is negotiable depending on experience



HOW TO APPLY

To help me find people who have read this properly:

1. Start your application with "UK Sourcing – [your first name]"

2. Include a short video (90 seconds max) introducing yourself and your experience with Amazon



Applications without both will not be reviewed. Shortlisted candidates will be invited to an interview and short trial task.

WHAT WE OFFER:

SCHEDULE:

title: INSIDE SALES AGENT (ISA)
description:
Location: Remote | Supporting Our New York Real Estate Operations

Employment Type: Part-Time (Opportunity to Transition to Full-Time)



About Us



At Team Musso Real Estate, we are a fast-growing, highly dynamic real estate team based on

Long Island, New York, dedicated to delivering exceptional client experiences and innovative

real estate solutions.



With over 25 years of industry experience, our team focuses on residential real estate, new

construction, investment opportunities, and real estate development.



We thrive on innovation, collaboration, technology, accountability, and forward-thinking

strategies.



We are looking for a highly motivated, persuasive, organized, and results-driven Inside Sales

Agent (ISA) who can think three steps ahead, communicate confidently with prospective clients,

and turn conversations into meaningful business opportunities.



If you are passionate about sales, enjoy building relationships, and have the drive to generate

leads and secure appointments, we want to hear from you!



Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced Inside Sales Agent (ISA) to support our growing real estate

operations.



This position focuses on outbound prospecting, lead generation, lead qualification,

relationship building, appointment setting, and consistent follow-up with prospective buyers,

sellers, investors, and property owners.



The successful candidate will proactively identify opportunities, engage prospects through phone

calls, text messages,
s, and CRM campaigns, and convert qualified leads into appointments

for our licensed real estate professionals.



This is not simply a cold-calling position. We want someone who understands how to develop

relationships, identify opportunities, overcome objections, and consistently move leads through

the sales pipeline.



The ideal candidate is self-motivated, confident, organized, tech-savvy, and comfortable working

in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment.



Key Responsibilities



1. Lead Generation & Prospecting

• Conduct outbound calls to prospective buyers, sellers, investors, and property owners.

• Identify new business opportunities through prospecting and database outreach.

• Contact new, existing, and previously inactive leads.

• Reconnect with past clients and prospects to identify potential real estate opportunities.

• Conduct follow-up calls,
s, and text messages.

• Research prospective clients and identify potential business opportunities.

• Generate qualified leads for the company's real estate sales team.

• Consistently meet established daily, weekly, and monthly prospecting goals.



2. Lead Qualification & Appointment Setting

• Engage prospective clients in professional, meaningful conversations.

• Identify client needs, motivation, timeline, and readiness to buy or sell.

• Qualify leads based on company-established criteria.

• Schedule appointments and consultations for licensed real estate agents.

• Confirm appointments and coordinate handoffs to the appropriate team members.

• Follow up with prospects who are not yet ready to make a decision.

• Maintain relationships with prospective clients through consistent communication.

• Focus on converting conversations into qualified appointments and business

opportunities.



3. CRM Management & Lead Tracking

• Maintain accurate and detailed records of all prospect interactions.

• Update lead status, contact information, notes, and follow-up activities.

• Organize and manage leads throughout the sales pipeline.

• Use Follow Up Boss (FUB) and other company CRM platforms to manage daily

activities.

• Create and complete follow-up tasks.

• Ensure no qualified leads are overlooked or neglected.

• Identify duplicate, outdated, or incomplete lead records.

• Maintain accurate records of appointments, callbacks, and prospect activity.



4. Sales Communication & Relationship Building

• Build rapport and establish trust with prospective clients.

• Communicate professionally and confidently over the phone.

• Handle objections effectively and professionally.

• Ask strategic questions to identify client needs and motivation.

• Maintain a positive, persistent, and solutions-oriented approach.

• Adapt communication strategies based on prospect responses.

• Demonstrate strong listening skills and attention to detail.

title: Social Media Manager
description:
Please send a Loom Video expressing your interest in this position and reviewing your experience



About the role



We're hiring a Social Media Manager to own Trade Launch's social presence end to end: the calendar, the team that produces it, and the results it drives. You report directly to the CMO, who sets the strategy. Your job is to turn that strategy into a calendar that ships on time, every day, across every channel.



Trade Launch is a business coaching company for painting contractors and home service owners. We help owners build the systems, team and sales engine to grow, drawing on the playbook behind a successful multi-million dollar painting company. Our content features our coaches, our clients and our team, and it has to sound like operators talking to operators.

We're looking for an elite, self-directed operator who can lead a small creative team, hold people accountable without being chased, and still jump in to edit and post themselves when it matters.



At a glance



Reports to: CMO

Manages: a content coordinator/scheduler and video editors

Channels: Instagram,
, YouTube, TikTok, plus LinkedIn and others as they become relevant

Location: Remote (international candidates welcome)

Hours: Full-time, US Eastern business hours



What you'll own



The content calendar, through and through

Build and maintain a rolling monthly calendar at least 60 days ahead, mapped to our content pillars and funnel stages (top: reach, middle: educate, bottom: act).

Track every post from idea to published: footage status (have vs. need), editor assigned, draft, review, approval, scheduled, live.

Fold launches and campaigns into the calendar without being asked: webinars, events and conferences, course updates, client-story series, promotions.

Execution of the strategy

Take the CMO's high-level strategy (pillars, funnel mix, goals) and turn it into a channel-by-channel plan, formats, hooks and briefs.

Write clear editing briefs: the angle, the hook, the cut, reference examples, length and format per platform.

Repurpose long-form content (coaching calls, webinars, client stories, event footage) into short-form clips, carousels and posts across channels.

Write captions, hooks and on-screen text in the Trade Launch brand voice: confident, practical, operator-to-operator, never gimmicky.

People and production

Lead the content coordinator and video editors day to day: assign work, set deadlines, review quality and give direct feedback.

Run a weekly production meeting and send a weekly report (see Success below).

Chase content from coaches, leadership and our videographer: request footage, book filming, collect raw files and keep the pipeline full.

Resolve priority conflicts before they stall work

Hands-on creation

Edit short-form video yourself when it's faster or the bar is higher

Performance and growth

Own social KPIs: reach, follower growth, engagement, watch time, saves and shares, and leads or calls sourced from social.

Spot trends early and bring recommendations on what to test, kill or double down on. Trends only make the cut when they fit how Trade Launch operates.

Evaluate new channels and propose a plan when one is worth adding.



How success is measured



You'll be measured on output first, then results. In the first 90 days, success means the backlog is gone, the calendar is always 30 days ahead, and leadership no longer has to ask where anything stands.



First 30 days

Audit every channel, the current calendar and the full footage backlog.

Meet each editor, the coordinator, the coaches and leadership; learn the brand voice and target client.

Ship a complete next-month calendar with every post's status and owner.

Set up the weekly report and production meeting rhythm.



First 60 days

Daily (and 2x daily) posting on Instagram and
 with no missed days.

Backlog cleared or scheduled, including the client-story series.

A working footage pipeline with coaches: who films what, when, and where it lands.

First monthly performance review with recommendations.



First 90 days

Calendar consistently 60+ days ahead across all active channels.

YouTube and TikTok running on a set cadence; a recommendation on LinkedIn.

Measurable lift in reach, engagement and follower growth against the day-one baseline.

The team runs without leadership chasing any individual task.

Ongoing KPIs

Posts published vs. planned (target: 100%)

Calendar lead time (target: 60+ days)

Follower growth, reach, engagement rate, watch time, saves and shares per channel

Leads, webinar registrations and calls attributed to organic social

Turnaround time from raw footage to published post

Your weekly report (every week, no exceptions)

Links to every piece of work in progress

What shipped vs. what you said would ship last week

What will ship next week, by owner

Blockers and what you need, with a date



Who you are



You're the person teams lean on because things simply get done when you own them. You don't wait to be told, you don't need reminders, and you tell your manager about a problem before they find it.



Must-haves



4+ years in social media, including 2+ years owning strategy execution and a content calendar for a brand or agency clients.

Proven experience managing editors, designers or coordinators: assigning, reviewing and holding them to deadlines.

Strong short-form video editing skills (CapCut, Premiere Pro, or similar). You can cut a scroll-stopping reel yourself.

Basic design skills (Canva, Figma) for carousels and thumbnails.

Deep, current knowledge of Instagram,
, TikTok and YouTube: algorithms, formats, hooks, trends and analytics.

Excellent written and spoken English. Clear, concise, proactive communication across Slack,
 and video calls.

Highly organized with project management tools (ClickUp, Asana, Notion, Monday or similar) and scheduling tools (Meta Business Suite, Later, Metricool or similar).

Comfortable reading performance data and turning it into decisions.

Able to translate high-level marketing strategy (pillars, funnels, audience) into a concrete plan without hand-holding.

Available to work US Eastern business hours, reliably.



Nice-to-haves



Experience with coaching, education, B2B or home services brands (painting, contracting, trades).

LinkedIn and YouTube long-form growth experience.

Experience with Meta ads or boosted posts.

Familiarity with GoHighLevel or another CRM for tracking leads from social.

Hours, location and logistics

Full-time, remote. Open to candidates worldwide.

Hours: Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM US Eastern, with real-time availability for meetings and Slack. Occasional flexibility around launches and events.



Setup: Reliable high-speed internet, a backup connection plan, a computer that can handle video editing, and a quiet space with a working webcam.





Start date: As soon as possible.

We deliver personalised, one-to-one Maths and English tuition to primary-school children across the United Kingdom.



We are seeking an **experienced, engaging and highly capable Online Maths Tutor** to join our growing teaching team.



### What You'll Do



- Deliver interactive, one-to-one online Maths lessons to UK students in Years 3–6.

- Teach key primary Maths topics, including arithmetic, fractions, decimals, percentages, measurement, geometry and problem-solving.

- Identify learning gaps and adapt lessons to each child's ability and pace.

- Explain mathematical concepts clearly using digital whiteboards, visual aids and practical examples.

- Monitor student progress and provide brief feedback after each lesson.

- Follow AClass Academy's curriculum, teaching standards and lesson schedules.



### What We're Looking For



- **Strong Maths Knowledge:** Excellent understanding of primary-level Mathematics and the ability to explain concepts simply.

- **Online Teaching Experience:** Proven experience teaching children online, preferably aged 7–11.

- **Excellent English Communication:** Clear, articulate spoken English and the ability to engage effectively with UK children.

- **Engaging Teaching Style:** Patient, encouraging, enthusiastic and skilled at keeping young learners focused.

- **Technical Readiness:** Own laptop or desktop, reliable high-speed internet, backup connectivity/power arrangements and a quiet teaching environment.

- **Reliability:** Excellent punctuality, professionalism and commitment to consistent weekly teaching slots.



**Highly Desirable**



- Experience teaching the UK National Curriculum (Key Stage 2).

- Experience preparing children for UK 11+ entrance examinations.

- A degree in Mathematics, Education, Engineering, STEM or a related discipline.

- Experience teaching British or international students.



UK curriculum experience is preferred but not essential. Suitable candidates will receive curriculum guidance and onboarding.



### Working Hours



Our students are based in the UK, so weekday lessons primarily take place during UK after-school hours.



- **Weekdays:** Approximately 11:30 PM–4:30 AM Philippine Time during UK winter, shifting one hour later during British Summer Time.

- **Weekends:** Additional opportunities during Philippine afternoon and evening hours.

- **Schedule:** Flexible part-time hours with regular, pre-agreed weekly teaching slots.



Applicants must be comfortable teaching during their chosen time slots.



### How to Apply



Please provide:



1. Your CV/resume and a brief summary of your online Maths teaching experience.

2. Details of any UK curriculum, KS2 or 11+ teaching experience.

3. Your available teaching days and hours (Philippine Time).

4. Your expected hourly rate in PHP or USD.

5. Confirmation of your internet speed, computer setup and backup arrangements.



Shortlisted applicants will be invited to deliver a live demonstration lesson.



**Join AClass Academy and help young learners develop confidence and a genuine understanding of Mathematics.**

title: Construction Project Coordinator – Commercial Construction (Remote)
description:
The Opportunity

We are seeking an experienced Construction Project Coordinator to support an established commercial construction, renovation, and facility maintenance company serving the Twin Cities and surrounding communities in Minnesota and Wisconsin. This part-time remote opportunity focuses on implementing, organizing, and maintaining project management processes using Contractor Foreman.



Working directly with the internal team and reporting to the President, you will help establish consistent documentation, improve administrative workflows, and keep multiple construction projects organized and up to date. This is a long-term opportunity for a proactive professional who enjoys taking ownership of systems, improving operational efficiency, and supporting a growing construction business.



Schedule: Part-time, approximately 20 hours per week, with potential to increase hours as responsibilities grow. Consistent availability during agreed working hours, with overlap during U.S. Central Time business hours, is required.



Key Responsibilities:

- Contractor Foreman Management: Support software implementation, configure project templates and workflows, organize existing and new projects, and maintain accurate project information and statuses.

- Construction Project Administration: Maintain project files, schedules, contracts, proposals, drawings, photographs, purchase orders, change orders, and other essential documentation.

- Daily Project Monitoring: Review daily logs, employee time entries, open work orders, and project updates to identify missing information and ensure records remain current.

- Team Coordination: Proactively follow up with project managers, field personnel, and internal team members regarding outstanding documentation, approvals, and project requirements.

- Financial Documentation Support: Track purchase orders and approved change orders, organize subcontractor invoices, and prepare completed project documentation for invoicing and closeout.

- Workflow Optimization: Develop and maintain standardized administrative procedures, improve documentation processes, and identify opportunities to reduce manual administrative work.

- Management Reporting: Provide regular updates on project statuses, outstanding items, and administrative priorities while independently coordinating multiple active projects.



Compensation:

Competitive monthly compensation based on experience and role scope.



Monthly compensation ranges from ₱33,000 – ₱43,000, depending on experience and role scope. Final compensation is aligned with the candidate's experience level.



Required Skills:

Core Technical Skills Required:

- 2–5 years of relevant experience in construction administration, project coordination, or construction project management support.

- Experience using construction project management software, with Contractor Foreman experience required.

- Knowledge of construction documentation, including purchase orders, change orders, contracts, invoices, daily logs, and project closeout requirements.

- Proficiency in Microsoft Office, Excel, Outlook, and digital document management.

- Experience coordinating multiple projects, maintaining project records, and developing standardized administrative workflows.



Professional Skills Required:

- Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage competing priorities with minimal supervision.

- Professional English communication skills, proactive follow-through, and accountability when coordinating with internal teams.



Candidate Fit:

- A self-directed professional who identifies missing information, follows up independently, and takes ownership of assigned responsibilities.

- A process-oriented individual who enjoys creating consistency, maintaining accurate records, and improving administrative efficiency.

- A dependable coordinator comfortable supporting multiple construction projects and collaborating with U.S.-based teams. 

- Previous experience with commercial construction or facility maintenance companies is advantageous.



Professional Readiness:

Candidates applying for this role should have a reliable home office setup, stable internet connection, and the ability to maintain consistent availability during the required working hours.



Successful candidates communicate proactively, meet deadlines, and take ownership of responsibilities while working remotely.



Candidates must also be willing to complete a background check as part of the selection process.



Application Process:

- Your professional background

- The types of work you specialize in

On a daily basis, you will work with the Development team, UI/UX team, Technical Writing team, Support team, and other company members to help us produce high-quality web and mobile products to keep our customers productive, successful, and happy. The team is primarily conducting manual testing, using a more ad hoc testing approach as opposed to a structured, fully documented one. We are working on growing our library of automated tests at the UI level, with plans to expand into the API level in the not-too-distant future.



Qualifications



1. Have at least 2 years of black box manual testing experience with a web product and knowledge of industry standards for web products. 

2. Strong knowledge of software QA methodologies, tools and processes, as well as the software development lifecycle. 

3. Excellent communication skills to report defects effectively and to alert the team to perceived risks. 

4. Ability to successfully estimate, prioritize, plan and coordinate various testing activities, sometimes for multiple projects at once. 

5. Curious nature and not afraid to ask questions.

6. Adaptable and capable of shifting gears quickly while working on interesting new features and learning new skills. 

7. Embrace a family culture and team environment by being willing to collaborate with, learn from, and share your knowledge with the team. 

8. Have a good understanding of where software might fail at various levels of the technology stack and be able to research a potential issue thoroughly to assess the risk and determine the scope.



Bonus Skills



1. Automation in Testing experience, preferably with Katalon Studio and/or Groovy/JavaScript or similar tool. 

2. Mobile app testing experience with Android and iOS. 

3. Quality engineering or management experience to help guide the team and facilitate continuous improvement. 

4. SQL experience. 

5. API testing experience.

title: Content Strategist / Social Media Manager
description:
We are hiring a Content Strategist / Social Media Manager to plan, produce, and execute content across Instagram,
, LinkedIn, and TikTok for an established personal brand in the video marketing and monetization space.



This is a hybrid role. You will own the content planning process — building monthly plans, writing hooks, scripting videos, and tracking trends — AND you will execute that plan day to day: scheduling, publishing, managing the content calendar, and monitoring performance. Content direction and final approval come from Keenya, but you are the person who turns her vision into a running system that never misses a beat.



You will have room to bring your own instincts to formatting, execution, and idea generation. 



But this is not a role where you are setting the brand's overall strategic direction from scratch. The win here is doing excellent work inside a clear system: planning with precision, executing with speed, and speaking up when something is working or when it is not.



About the Brand



Keenya Kelly is a video marketing and monetization strategist with a large established audience across TikTok, Instagram, LinkedIn, and
. We teach entrepreneurs how to grow through short vertical video and turn their content into consistent income. We are a systems-driven team that moves fast, especially during launch periods, and we need someone who can keep pace without needing constant hand-holding.



What This Role Actually Is



You are the engine that keeps content moving every day — from the planning stage all the way through to publishing. You will build the content plans, write the hooks and captions, track what is trending, and then bring all of that to life across platforms on schedule. You bring enough of your own judgment to catch what is working, flag what is not, and suggest adjustments in real time.



We are not looking for someone who only follows instructions with no instincts of their own. We want someone with a genuine feel for short vertical video who can plan strategically, execute at a high level, and speak up when something is not landing.



What We Are Looking For



1. You can plan content that actually drives results

You build monthly content plans that include filming briefs, on-screen text hooks, talking points or scripts, captions, and platform-specific variations for TikTok, Instagram,
, and LinkedIn. Every piece aligns with our content pillars, audience stage, and sales goals so each video moves people toward a clear next step.



2. You have a real feel for short vertical video

You understand pacing, hooks, text overlay timing, and what makes a piece of content stop the scroll. You track current trends, audios, and formats on TikTok and Instagram and turn them into content ideas that fit our brand — not just follow trends blindly.



3. You can execute at volume, reliably

You manage content calendars, schedule and publish across multiple platforms, and keep everything organized without things falling through the cracks — especially during launch periods when volume increases. You keep a clean, organized tracker so the team always knows what is approved, filmed, and scheduled.



4. You write hooks that stop the scroll and captions that sound human

You write on-screen text hooks that make people stop scrolling. Your captions feel like a real conversation, not a sales pitch. You have a natural sense of voice and can write in a style that sounds like the person posting — not like generic marketing copy.



5. You are proactive, not just responsive

You flag what is underperforming, suggest small tweaks, and bring ideas to the table — without needing to own the entire strategic direction. You know the difference between "I have a suggestion" and "I am going to change the plan."



6. You are highly organized and communicative

You meet deadlines without being chased, you do not go quiet when things get busy, and you are comfortable working inside an established system with clear processes. You submit plans on a set schedule and revise them quickly based on feedback.



7. You are comfortable working under direction from the brand owner

This role reports into content direction set by Keenya. You should want that structure, not resent it. You take direction well and give thoughtful input without needing to own every decision.



What This Role Involves



Planning

Building monthly content plans with filming briefs, on-screen text hooks, talking points or scripts, captions, and platform-specific variations

Tracking current trends, audios, and formats on TikTok and Instagram and turning them into on-brand content ideas

Aligning every piece with content pillars, audience stage, and sales goals

Submitting plans on a set schedule and revising quickly based on feedback

Execution

Publishing and scheduling content across Instagram,
, LinkedIn, and TikTok

Managing and maintaining the content calendar

Executing hooks, scripts, captions, and CTAs as directed, with room for your own polish on formatting and delivery

Keeping content organized in our shared systems (Google Workspace, ManyChat, Metricool)

Performance and Communication

Monitoring performance day to day and flagging what is working or not

Adapting quickly and staying responsive during active launches, live challenges, webinars, and campaigns

Communicating proactively — daily check-ins during active periods



You Are the Right Fit If...

You have real experience both planning and executing content at volume across multiple platforms

You understand short vertical video and can write strong hooks, plan pacing, and direct text overlays

You have a track record of creating content that drives engagement and turns into sales

You are highly organized and reliable with deadlines

You communicate proactively and do not disappear when things get busy

You are comfortable executing someone else's strategic direction while still bringing your own instincts to the work

You have strong written communication and a natural sense of voice

You have experience with spreadsheets, project trackers, and content management tools

You have a warm, collaborative personality — you will be part of a small team that works hard and has fun doing it



This Is Not the Right Role If...

You want to set the overall brand strategy yourself

You need full creative ownership over every decision

You struggle with deadlines, communication, or structured systems

You are only comfortable posting content, without any instinct for what is actually working

You are only comfortable planning content, without the ability to manage day-to-day publishing



Nice to Have

Experience in creator education, coaching, or marketing for women entrepreneurs

Familiarity with
 funnels and launch sequences



How to Apply

Start your application message with the word TIKTOK to confirm you have read the full posting. 



Then answer the screening questions below and attach your resume and two or three examples of content you have planned or created that performed well, with results if you have them.



Your application should also include:

A brief note on your experience executing content across TikTok, Instagram,
, and LinkedIn — what platforms, what volume, what tools you have used

One or two examples of accounts where you handled both planning and execution — what your role was specifically, and what the results looked like

Your availability for a full-time role



Applications that are vague or do not include specifics on your actual planning and execution experience will not be reviewed.



Screening Questions

Walk us through a piece of content you planned that turned into sales. What was the hook, the format, the CTA, and the result?

Which TikTok or Instagram trend are you watching right now? Explain why it is working and how you would adapt it for women business owners.

Write a sample on-screen text hook (one line) for a video about why women business owners should stop waiting to feel ready before they start filming. Then give a second hook that uses a contrarian angle.

Our plans are due on a set day each month. Describe a time you met a tight deadline while keeping quality high. How did you prioritize?

How do you keep a content calendar organized when you are managing many pieces at once? What tools or systems do you use?

How do you make sure captions sound like the person who is posting them and not like generic marketing copy?

Tell us about a time you received feedback that changed your approach. How did you respond?

What does a healthy working relationship with a content owner look like to you, and how do you handle it when your ideas are not chosen?

Our team is small and works closely together. What do you enjoy most about collaborating on a creative team?

What is your availability each week, and what time zone are you working in?

title: 3D Architectural Renderer
description:

Industry: Architecture & Interior Design

Employment Type: Full-Time

Work Arrangement: Remote – Philippines-based

Work Schedule: 40 hours per week, preferably 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM (client's time zone, subject to

confirmation)



Position Overview

We are looking for a highly skilled 3D Architectural Renderer to support an architecture and

interior design firm handling residential and commercial projects.

The ideal candidate will have strong experience in 3D architectural visualization, modeling, and

photorealistic rendering. This individual will be responsible for transforming architectural

drawings, floor plans, design concepts, and references into realistic, high-quality 3D visual

presentations.



The candidate should have a strong eye for design, lighting, materials, textures, and spatial

composition, with the ability to produce professional renderings that accurately communicate

the firm's design concepts to clients.



We are looking for someone who can work independently, manage rendering projects,

incorporate feedback, and consistently deliver high-quality outputs with minimal supervision.



Key Responsibilities

1. 3D Architectural Modeling

• Develop detailed 3D models of residential and commercial architectural spaces.

• Translate 2D architectural drawings, floor plans, elevations, and design references into

accurate 3D models.

• Create interior and exterior architectural models, including walls, ceilings, flooring,

furniture, fixtures, and architectural elements.

• Ensure 3D models accurately reflect architectural dimensions, layouts, and design

specifications.

• Modify and refine models based on architectural revisions and client feedback.

2. Photorealistic Rendering & Visualization

• Produce high-quality, photorealistic interior and exterior renderings.

• Create realistic lighting, shadows, materials, textures, finishes, and environmental

elements.

• Develop architectural perspectives, walkthroughs, and presentation-ready visualizations

when required.

• Prepare rendering views that effectively communicate the overall design concept and

atmosphere.

• Ensure visual consistency across different views and project presentations.

• Enhance rendered images through post-processing and image editing when necessary.

3. Design Interpretation & Collaboration

• Interpret architectural drawings, sketches, mood boards, and design references.

• Collaborate with architects and interior designers to understand project requirements

and design intent.

• Recommend appropriate materials, finishes, lighting, and visual treatments to improve

presentation quality.

• Incorporate design revisions and feedback accurately.

• Identify inconsistencies between architectural drawings and 3D models and proactively

raise concerns.

4. Project Management & Quality Control

• Manage assigned rendering projects from initial references through final delivery.

• Organize project files, 3D models, textures, materials, and rendering outputs.

• Ensure all deliverables meet the firm's visual quality standards.

• Meet project deadlines while maintaining attention to detail.

• Provide regular progress updates and communicate potential delays or technical

challenges.

• Work independently with minimal supervision and follow-ups.



Required Qualifications

• Proven experience as a 3D Architectural Renderer, Architectural Visualizer, 3D Artist, or

similar role.

• Strong portfolio showcasing photorealistic architectural renderings.

• Experience creating both interior and exterior architectural visualizations.

• Proficiency in at least one professional 3D modeling and rendering software.

• Strong understanding of lighting, materials, textures, composition, and perspective.

• Ability to interpret architectural floor plans, elevations, sections, and design references.

• Knowledge of architectural design principles, interior design concepts, and building

materials.

• Strong attention to detail and visual accuracy.

• Good English communication skills, both written and verbal.

• Ability to work independently, manage multiple projects, and meet deadlines.



Preferred Qualifications

• Experience working with US-based architecture and interior design firms.

• Experience handling residential and commercial architectural projects.

• Familiarity with Autodesk Revit and BIM workflows.

• Experience creating high-end architectural presentations for clients.

• Knowledge of post-processing tools such as Adobe Photoshop.

• Experience producing architectural walkthroughs, animations, or 360-degree

visualizations.



Software & Tools

Preferred Software:

• Autodesk Revit – For architectural models and project coordination.

• Enscape – For real-time architectural visualization and rendering.

• Lumion – For realistic architectural rendering and presentations.

• D5 Render – For photorealistic interior and exterior visualization.

• V-Ray – For advanced rendering and lighting.

• 3ds Max – For advanced 3D modeling and visualization.

• SketchUp – For 3D architectural modeling.

• Adobe Photoshop – For post-processing and image enhancemen
