title: Level 2 MSP Technician
description:
Job Description - Level 2 MSP Technicians

About the Roles

We are hiring Level 2 and Level 3 technicians for our MSP, supporting multiple small and mid-size business

clients. Both roles are full-time and remote, based in the Philippines, working US Eastern business hours (exact

shift to be confirmed).

The two levels do mostly the same work. Level 2 owns escalated tickets from Level 1 and Fast Track. Level 3

handles the same work plus the most complex issues, projects, and mentoring.



What Both Levels Do

• Resolve escalated tickets within SLA: Windows endpoints, user profiles, printers, applications, and

remote users.

• Administer Microsoft 365: users, licenses, mailboxes, shared mailboxes, groups, SharePoint, OneDrive,

and Teams.

• Troubleshoot Exchange Online mail flow, spam and quarantine, and Outlook issues.

• Support Entra ID and Intune: MFA, device enrollment, and compliance policies.

• Troubleshoot networks: DNS, DHCP, VPN, Wi-Fi, and VLANs on Sophos, SonicWall, Cisco, and UniFi gear.

• Support Windows Server, Active Directory, and Group Policy.

• Monitor backups and perform standard restores.

• Work in our PSA (Autotask/Thread) and remote tools (ScreenConnect), with complete ticket notes.

• Perform root-cause analysis on recurring issues.

• Write clear customer updates that a non-technical client can follow.

• Document configurations, procedures, and fixes so the team can reuse them.



Level 2: Requirements

Level 2 owns the shared work above and escalates only what needs Level 3 or a project engineer. Typical tickets:

• A user cannot receive external
, or a shared mailbox stopped syncing.

• MFA lockout, or a new device that will not enroll in Intune.

• VPN drops for one user or one office.

• A shared drive or GPO mapping fails for a group of users.

• Escalate security i
 when needed.

Required:

• 3-4 years in IT support, including 2+ years in an MSP or multi-client environment.

• Hands-on Microsoft 365 administration, including Exchange Online.

• Working knowledge of Entra ID and Active Directory.

• Solid Windows 10/11 troubleshooting.

• Networking fundamentals: DNS, DHCP, TCP/IP, VPN.

• Experience with at least one firewall or network platform (Sophos, SonicWall, UniFi, or similar).

• Experience with a PSA or ticketing system and a remote support tool.

• Excellent written and spoken English.

• Ability to work US Eastern hours reliably, with stable internet and power.

• Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills, and the ability to work independently while managing

several issues at once.

title: Real Estate Acquisitions Closer / Seller Solutions Specialist – Must Have Seller Negotiation Experience
description:
REAL ESTATE SELLER CLOSER – ACQUISITIONS, LISTINGS & SELLER SOLUTIONS



We are ONLY hiring an EXPERIENCED **Real Estate Seller Closer** to work with warm and qualified U.S. property-owner leads and move seller conversations toward signed agreements, listings, competitive-sale programs, or another clear commitment.



**THIS IS NOT A COLD-CALLING OR APPOINTMENT-SETTING POSITION.**



Our prospecting team makes the initial contact. You will primarily work with property owners who have already expressed interest, requested information, spoken with our team, or require continued follow-up.



We're looking for someone who has personally done more than qualify leads.



You should have experience speaking directly with motivated property sellers, presenting offers or selling strategies, discussing and negotiating price, handling objections, asking for a commitment, following sellers until a decision is reached, and helping obtain signed purchase agreements, listings, or other committed seller opportunities.



If your experience is primarily cold calling, qualifying leads, and scheduling appointments for another closer, this is probably not the right position.



## ABOUT OUR SELLER PROGRAMS



We operate multiple seller programs, including **Seller Options Now** and **Realty Offers Now**.



Unlike companies that offer homeowners only one way to sell, our business evaluates several possible solutions based on the seller's property, priorities, timing, and financial objectives.



Potential solutions may include:



- Direct cash/investor purchase

- Traditional real estate listing

- Competitive online sale

- Offer-to-Sold / accelerated-sale strategy

- Other structured seller solutions

- Continued nurture when the seller is not ready today



Your job is **not to force every homeowner into a cash offer**.



Your job is to understand the seller's situation, determine the appropriate path, explain the options clearly, and move the seller toward a decision.



## YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES



- Call warm and previously qualified seller leads

- Follow up with sellers who have already spoken with our team

- Build rapport quickly with U.S. homeowners

- Determine motivation, timing, property condition, price expectations, equity/payoff, and decision-making factors

- Ask meaningful discovery questions instead of simply reading a script

- Discuss property value and seller expectations

- Present appropriate seller solutions

- Handle pricing objections professionally

- Negotiate price and terms when appropriate

- Maintain control and direction of seller conversations

- Ask for the business and establish clear next steps

- Recognize when a seller should move toward a direct purchase, traditional listing, competitive-sale strategy, or continued nurture

- Maintain disciplined long-term follow-up

- Keep complete and accurate CRM notes

- Create and manage follow-up tasks

- Maintain accurate stages, tags, and pipeline status

- Communicate important seller opportunities to management

- Help move opportunities from seller interest to signed agreements and completed transactions



## EXPERIENCE WE ARE LOOKING FOR



Strong candidates may have previous experience as a:



- Real Estate Acquisition Manager

- Real Estate Acquisitions Specialist

- Motivated Seller Closer

- Wholesale Acquisition Manager

- Seller Lead Manager

- Listing Conversion Specialist

- Real Estate Sales Closer

- Disposition Manager with seller-side experience

- Experienced Real Estate ISA who progressed into actual closing responsibility



Experience speaking directly with **U.S. property owners is strongly preferred**.



You should be comfortable speaking with sellers involving:



- Inherited properties

- Vacant properties

- Landlords

- Properties needing repairs

- Distressed properties

- Relocation

- Financial pressure

- Pre-foreclosure / foreclosure situations

- Sellers considering a Realtor

- Sellers comparing cash offers

- Sellers with unrealistic price expectations

- Sellers who require repeated follow-up before making a decision



## FOLLOW UP BOSS / CRM EXPERIENCE



**Follow Up Boss experience is strongly preferred.**



Ideal candidates already understand:



- Contacts

- Notes

- Tasks

- Calling

- Text messaging

-

- Stages

- Tags

- Smart Lists

- Action Plans

- Follow-up

- Pipeline management



If you are a proven real estate seller closer but have not personally used Follow Up Boss, we may still consider you if you have strong experience with another real estate CRM and can learn new systems quickly.



## THIS IS NOT THE RIGHT POSITION IF YOU:



- Primarily schedule appointments for another salesperson

- Only have cold-calling experience

- Have never personally negotiated price or terms with property owners

- Have never asked a seller to sign a purchase agreement, listing, or similar commitment

- Depend completely on a script

- Are uncomfortable discussing money

- Give up after the first objection

- Do not follow up consistently

- Need someone to tell you every day who to call

- Fail to maintain detailed CRM records



We want someone who understands the difference between **having a conversation and advancing a deal**.



## COMMUNICATION REQUIREMENTS



Excellent spoken and written English is required.



Because you will speak directly with U.S. homeowners, your telephone communication must be professional, natural, confident, conversational, and easy to understand.



We care more about your ability to communicate, listen, negotiate, and close than we do about having a perfect résumé.



## WORKING HOURS



You must be available during **U.S. Eastern Time business hours and early-evening seller contact hours**.



The position is expected to begin at approximately **30 hours per week**, with the opportunity to expand based on performance and lead volume.



## COMPENSATION



Base compensation depends on verified experience, production history, and demonstrated closing ability.



Expected range:



**$800–$2,000 USD per month**



Additional performance incentives may be available for results such as:



- Signed acquisition agreements

- Signed listings

- Competitive-sale enrollments

- Closed transactions



We are looking for a long-term team member. Strong performance can lead to increased responsibility and compensation.



## REMOTE WORK REQUIREMENTS



You must have:



- Reliable high-speed internet

- Reliable computer

- Professional headset with microphone

- Quiet and professional calling environment

- Ability to participate in video meetings

- Reliable availability during agreed U.S. hours



Backup internet and backup power are strongly preferred.



## HOW TO APPLY



**We will not consider generic applications. ****



Start your application with the words:



**I CLOSE SELLER LEADS**



Then answer every question below.



### 1. SELLER EXPERIENCE



Describe your experience speaking directly with motivated U.S. property sellers.



### 2. PREVIOUS REAL ESTATE COMPANIES



What real estate companies, investors, brokerages, or acquisition teams have you worked with?



Include:



- Company name

- Dates

- Your exact role

- What YOU personally handled



### 3. CLOSER OR APPOINTMENT SETTER?



Were you personally responsible for presenting offers, negotiating price, and asking sellers to sign agreements?



Or did you primarily qualify the seller and hand the opportunity to another closer?



Be specific.



### 4. SELLER VOLUME



In an average month, approximately how many seller opportunities did YOU personally handle?



### 5. ACTUAL RESULTS



In an average month, how many of the following did YOU personally obtain?



- Signed purchase agreements

- Signed listings

- Other committed seller opportunities



**Do not include appointments, qualified leads, or opportunities passed to another closer.**



### 6. ACTUAL TRANSACTION



Walk us through **one actual seller transaction you personally handled**.



Include:



- Seller's initial asking price

- Your initial offer or recommended strategy

- Seller's main objection

- What you said or did

- Final negotiated price or outcome

- What agreement was signed

- Whether YOU personally obtained the signature



### 7. FOLLOW UP BOSS / CRM



Describe your experience with **Follow Up Boss**.



Tell us specifically which Follow Up Boss features you have personally used.



If you have not used Follow Up Boss, tell us which real estate CRM you have used instead.



### 8. SELLER PRICE OBJECTION



A homeowner tells you:



**“Zillow says my house is worth $250,000, so I'm not taking $190,000.” ****



Write exactly what you would say next as if you were actually speaking with the seller.



Do not explain your sales strategy.



### 9. REALTOR OBJECTION



A homeowner says:



**“I'm not in a hurry. I'll list it with a Realtor if I don't get my price.”**



Write exactly how you would continue the conversation.



### 10. DIFFICULT SELLER OBJECTION



Tell us about one difficult seller objection you successfully overcame.



What was the objection, what did you say or do, and what happened?



### 11. MULTIPLE SELLER SOLUTIONS



Have you ever worked for a company that could offer sellers multiple solutions such as:



- Cash purchase

- Traditional listing

- Novation

- Competitive online sale

- Auction

- Seller financing

- Another structured sale strategy



Explain.



### 12. AVAILABILITY



What hours can you consistently work in U.S. Eastern Time?



### 13. COMPENSATION



What monthly base compensation are you seeking?



## REQUIRED VOICE OR VIDEO SAMPLE



Include a link to a **60–90 second voice or video introduction**.



Tell us:



- Your name

- Your real estate seller experience

- How long you have worked with U.S. property owners

- Your acquisitions or closing experience

- Your CRM / Follow Up Boss experience

- Why you believe you can close motivated seller leads



We may not consider applications without the requested information or a voice/video sample.



We are specifically looking for someone who has already moved property-owner conversations toward **signed purchase agreements, listings, or another definitive seller commitment**.



If you are an experienced seller closer looking for a long-term role where your ability to negotiate and convert opportunities is recognized and rewarded, we want to hear from you.

About Us



Matherne Industrial is a growing industrial services contractor serving chemical plants, manufacturing facilities, and industrial sites throughout the Houston, Texas industrial market.



Our services include industrial cleaning, facility maintenance, environmental services, soft crafts, and specialty industrial services.



We are a small company with aggressive growth plans, and I am looking for someone who wants to grow with us for the long term.

The position will start at approximately 3–4 hours per day, with the opportunity to grow substantially as the company grows.

Following up on leads, RFQs, proposals, and open opportunities

Gathering subcontractor, labor, material, and equipment pricing



Reviewing job costs and helping us maintain strong margins



Maintaining our CRM and sales pipeline



Tracking outstanding tasks and keeping the owner accountable to deadlines



Coordinating with our accounting/bookkeeping support

Helping build the back-office infrastructure necessary to scale the company

Excellent written and spoken English



Strong Excel / Google Sheets skills



Extremely organized and comfortable following up repeatedly

Willing to challenge numbers, ask questions, and help protect margins



Must have a U.S.-based phone number where I can call you directly



Looking for a long-term position, not temporary freelance work

Your previous title is not as important as your experience.

Industrial Engineer

Procurement Specialist

Estimator

Project Coordinator

Operations Coordinator

Supply Chain Professional

Oil & Gas Operations Professional

Your experience with quoting, estimating, procurement, operations, or business development

 your application to:

INDUSTRIAL GROWTH

title: DTC E-commerce Recruiter, Creative Team
description:
Full-Time | Remote | Reports to: Operations Manager



Who We Are



We move fast, we think big, and we hire for impact. If you have a sharp eye for DTC e-commerce talent, know how to identify high-performing creatives, and thrive in a fast-paced, results-driven environment, this is your opportunity to help build a winning creative team.



The Purpose of This Role



The purpose of the Recruiter at Brida is to find, attract and hire A-player creative talent so we can scale the brand further.

We are launching a new product with more than 20 positionings to test. Every strong creative strategist, video editor and creative producer we hire opens up a new positioning and more revenue. That makes this one of the highest-impact roles in the company. If we hire great people, the company grows fast. If we don't, we go backwards.

You understand that hiring for a DTC creative team is different from general recruiting. You know what a creative strategist does, what a strong video ad portfolio looks like, and why performance matters more than aesthetics. Your success is measured by the quality of the people you bring in and how well they perform, not by the number of interviews you run.



What You Will Do



Onboarding



Learn Brida's creative team structure, roles and how each role contributes to the ad account

Learn our full hiring process, from screening to test assessment to final call

Learn our onboarding, days off and payout processes



Ongoing Responsibilities



Source candidates through job boards, LinkedIn, 
 communities and direct outreach

Run high-volume, targeted outreach for open creative roles

Screen applications and portfolios, and filter out candidates who don't fit

Run first interviews and send test assessments to strong candidates

Coordinate test assessment reviews and second calls with our Creative Director

Keep the hiring pipeline organized and up to date in ClickUp

Onboard new hires into our processes, tools and team

Manage days off requests and make sure biweekly payouts are done on time

Join weekly performance reviews with the Creative Director and track new hire ramp checks

Keep job posts live and the pipeline full for our core creative roles



What We Are Looking For



Required Experience

Minimum 2 years of recruiting experience, ideally for eCommerce brands, DTC agencies or marketing teams

Proven experience hiring creative or marketing roles such as video editors, designers, creative strategists or media buyers

Hands-on HR admin experience: onboarding, leave tracking and payouts

Experience with high-volume outreach on LinkedIn and online communities

Experience with task management software such as ClickUp

Fluent English speaker and writer



Character Traits We Hire For



Great communicator, clear, proactive and professional with candidates and the team

Sharp judgment, able to spot an A-player and filter out the rest quickly

Highly organized, nothing slips through the cracks on your watch

Direct and confident, comfortable having honest conversations about performance

Humble and accountable, you take extreme ownership of both wins and failures

Resourceful problem-solver, you find great people in places others don't look

Results-driven, you care about who performs, not just who gets hired



This Is NOT For You If...



You have only recruited for admin or support roles and don't understand creative teams

You are not comfortable with high-volume outreach

You are not an organized person, this role lives and dies by systems and deadlines

You avoid difficult conversations

You don't thrive in a fast-paced, high-operating environment

You don't understand eCommerce and what drives people to buy

You are not passionate about growth, personally and professionally



Hours & Location



Full-time (40 hours per week)

Fully remote. Europe, Middle East or Asia time zones preferred

Paid Holidays

Paid Sick Days

Compensation



Monthly retainer plus a performance bonus for every hire who stays and performs.



Growth Potential



With strong results, your path may include:

Owning all hiring and people operations for Brida

Leading a talent team as the company grows

Becoming a key part of building a world-class creative team at a fast-scaling brand

Strong performers grow here. There is no ceiling for people who consistently deliver.



How to Apply



To make sure you've read the full post and are serious about the position, please send an application message that includes all of the following:



1. Your resume

2. Examples of creative or marketing roles you have hired for, with results

3. Your salary requirements



IMPORTANT: Applications that do not include the above will not be considered.

title: Executive Assistant/Real Estate Operations Specialist
description:
🚨 HIRING: ELITE EXECUTIVE ASSISTANT / GROWTH & OPERATIONS SPECIALIST

Remote | $20–$45/hour USD | Full-Time | Exceptional Growth Opportunity

Starting compensation is based on demonstrated ability and experience. We are willing to pay exceptionally well for someone who produces exceptional results. Rapid compensation increases and leadership opportunities are available to individuals who consistently exceed expectations

.We are not looking for an average Virtual Assistant.

We're looking for an exceptionally intelligent, hardworking, resourceful, and ambitious individual who wants to help build one of the largest home-buying companies in the United States.

Someone who doesn't just want to complete tasks and collect a paycheck.

Someone who wants to solve problems, help grow a business, take on increasing responsibility, and earn exceptionally well for the value they create.

We're willing to pay significantly more for genuinely exceptional talent.

🚀 ABOUT OUR COMPANY

Top Choice Cash Offers is a rapidly growing US real estate investment company.

Over approximately the past year, we've grown from $30,000/month to approximately $200,000/month in revenue.

Our next goal is to reach $500,000–$1,000,000/month within the next year.

Our long-term vision is to become the largest house-buying company in the United States.

We're looking for someone who wants to become a meaningful part of making that happen.

🔥 OUR CULTURE

We have a young, hungry, entrepreneurial leadership team with extremely ambitious goals.

We're intense about execution but calm about problems.

We operate with urgency. We move quickly, make decisions, solve problems, and expect people to follow through.

We don't enjoy unnecessary drama, excuses, delays, or overcomplicating things.

When something goes wrong, we don't panic. We stay composed, figure out the solution, and take action.

At the same time, we're not a stiff corporate environment.

We joke around, have fun, brainstorm ideas, challenge each other, and genuinely enjoy building the company.

We're looking for someone who brings that same positive, creative, ambitious energy.

HIGH URGENCY. LOW DRAMA. EXTREME OWNERSHIP.

🎯 THE PERSON WE WANT

We're looking for someone who:

* Is extremely resourceful and can figure out unfamiliar problems independently.

* Takes complete accountability for assigned responsibilities.

* Communicates proactively and executes with urgency.

* Is exceptionally organized and detail-oriented.

* Has strong written and spoken English.

* Is comfortable working with spreadsheets, technology, software, and data.

* Genuinely enjoys identifying inefficiencies and solving operational problems.

* Thinks beyond individual tasks and cares about business outcomes.

* Is financially motivated and excited about increasing their income through greater responsibility.

* Has a positive, energetic personality and enjoys working with ambitious people.

* Remains calm and solution-oriented under pressure.

* Wants to continuously improve and grow into a major role within a company.

Relevant executive assistance, operations, project coordination, or US real estate experience is preferred, but exceptional demonstrated ability matters most.

💼 YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

Initially:

* Track and organize company KPIs and performance data.

* Maintain spreadsheets, records, and operational dashboards.

* Assist with GoHighLevel, software, automation, and technology-related tasks.

* Coordinate notaries, photographers, staging companies, and vendors.

* Support real estate transaction and closing logistics.

* Organize paperwork, documentation, and company information.

* Manage assignments and follow-ups.

* Research solutions and complete time-sensitive projects.

As your skills and understanding of our business grow:

* Identify and fix operational bottlenecks.

* Help implement better processes and automation.

* Assist with recruiting, interviewing, and onboarding.

* Take ownership of company projects.

* Improve operational efficiency across departments.

* Help leadership execute new growth initiatives.

We're looking for someone who eventually asks, "What's holding the company back, and how can I help fix it?"

Not simply, "What's my next task?"

💰 COMPENSATION & OPPORTUNITY

Starting compensation: $20–$45/hour USD, depending on demonstrated ability, experience, location, and responsibilities.

We're not searching for the cheapest candidate.

We're searching for someone whose exceptional output justifies exceptional compensation.

Opportunities for performance-based bonuses, compensation increases, and advancement will be available as responsibilities grow and results are demonstrated.

We want you to become increasingly valuable to the company and be rewarded accordingly.

⏰ SCHEDULE & WORK ETHIC

Initial schedule: Approximately 40–50 hours per week, with availability aligned to US Eastern Time business operations.

As the company grows, we're particularly interested in someone who is enthusiastic about the possibility of taking on significantly more responsibility and additional paid hours.

This may involve exceptionally demanding periods, potentially 80–100-hour weeks, if mutually agreed upon, legally permitted, and appropriately compensated, with adequate rest and recovery. The 80-100 hour work weeks also depends on if your being compensated a lot more, and you have the skill to come in here and grow the business and your hours be worth it.

We're looking for someone who is genuinely excited about an ambitious, high-effort career path.

The goal is exceptional output and long-term impact, not simply working more hours.

⚠️ OUR EXPECTATIONS

Our standards are extremely high.

We expect urgency, accountability, excellent communication, accuracy, resourcefulness, and independent problem-solving.

We don't expect you to know everything.

We expect you to be exceptionally good at figuring things out.

We want someone we can trust with important responsibilities, who brings us solutions rather than repeatedly waiting for instructions.

🧠 HIRING PROCESS

We're extremely selective.

Our hiring process includes:

1. Written application.

2. Short practical screening exercise.

3. Paid, real-world skills assessment.

4. Final interview.

5. Paid working trial for selected finalists.

Applicants will not be invited to interview until they've demonstrated relevant capabilities.

title: UGC/HR Manager, Creative Team Hiring
description:
Full-Time | Remote | Reports to: Operations Manager



Who We Are



We move fast, we think big, and we reward performance. If you're passionate about discovering top UGC and creative talent, building high-performing teams, and streamlining recruitment and HR processes, this is your opportunity to play a key role in scaling a fast-growing DTC e-commerce brand.



The Purpose of This Role



The purpose of the UGC/HR Manager at Brida is to find, hire and manage the creative talent that scales our brand.

This role is built for UGC managers who are ready for a bigger impact. You already source people at volume, onboard them, make sure they deliver and make sure they get paid. At Brida, you'll do the same for the people who build our ads: creative strategists, video editors and creative producers.

As a UGC manager, you supported the creative team. Here, you build it. We have more than 20 new positionings to test, and every A-player you hire lets us scale another one.



What You Will Do



Onboarding



Learn Brida's creative team structure, roles and how each role contributes to the ad account

Learn our full hiring process, from screening to test assessment to final call

Learn our onboarding, days off and payout processes



Ongoing Responsibilities



Source candidates through job boards, LinkedIn, 
 communities and direct outreach

Run high-volume, targeted outreach for open creative roles

Screen applications and portfolios, run first interviews and send test assessments

Coordinate assessment reviews and second calls with our Creative Director

Onboard new hires into our processes, tools and team

Manage days off and make sure biweekly payouts are done on time

Join weekly performance reviews with the Creative Director and track new hire ramp checks

Keep the hiring pipeline organized and up to date in ClickUp

Bonus: source and manage UGC creators when UGC projects run



What We Are Looking For



Required Experience



Minimum 2 years as a UGC manager, creator manager or similar role at an eCommerce brand or agency

Has hired or managed skilled creative talent such as editors, strategists or designers, not only booked creators

Has owned onboarding, payments and day-to-day admin for a team of creators or contractors

Experience with high-volume outreach on LinkedIn, 
 and creator platforms

Experience with task management software such as ClickUp

Fluent English speaker and writer



Character Traits We Hire For



Great communicator, clear, proactive and professional with candidates and the team

Sharp eye for talent, you know what a strong creative portfolio looks like

Highly organized, you manage many people and deadlines without dropping the ball

Direct and confident, comfortable having honest conversations about performance

Humble and accountable, you take extreme ownership of both wins and failures

Resourceful problem-solver, you find great people in places others don't look

Hungry to grow into a full HR and people role



This Is NOT For You If...



You only want to work on UGC content

You have only booked creators and never hired or managed skilled talent

You avoid difficult conversations about performance

You are not an organized person, this role lives and dies by systems and deadlines

You don't thrive in a fast-paced, high-operating environment

You don't understand eCommerce and what drives people to buy

You are not passionate about growth, personally and professionally



Hours & Location



Full-time (40 hours per week)

Fully remote. Europe, Middle East or Asia time zones preferred

Paid Holidays

Paid Sick Days

Compensation

Monthly retainer plus a performance bonus for every hire who stays and performs.



Growth Potential



With strong results, your path may include:

Growing into a full HR Manager role, owning all people operations at Brida

Leading a talent team as the company grows

Becoming a key part of building a world-class creative team at a fast-scaling brand

Strong performers grow here. There is no ceiling for people who consistently deliver.



How to Apply



To make sure you've read the full post and are serious about the position, please send an application message that includes all of the following:



1. Your resume

2. Examples of creator programs or creative teams you have managed, with scale and results

3. Any experience hiring editors, strategists or other creative roles

4. Your salary requirements



IMPORTANT: Applications that do not include the above will not be considered.

title: Job Posting: Social Media & Music Promotion Virtual Assistant
description:
I'm hiring a remote, part-time virtual assistant to help grow my music audience online. You'll post on my behalf across Instagram, YouTube and TikTok, engage with fans, create simple graphics in Canva, help keep my website current, and find new communities where my music and work can connect.



About me: I'm an LA-based singer-songwriter and award-winning voice actor. My music is mythic, story-driven indie-folk, and I'm building toward a debut album. My audience sits where music, gaming, animation and fandom overlap, so this role is a great fit for someone who already lives in those worlds.



You'll work alongside my social media manager, who creates content and strategy. Your job is to get that content out into the world and keep the conversation going with fans.



What you'll do:



Posting and scheduling

• Post and schedule content to Instagram (feed, Reels, Stories), YouTube (videos and Shorts) and TikTok

• Write or adapt captions, hashtags and descriptions in my voice

• Pull ready-to-post content from our shared Notion workspace, where my social media manager stages it



Fan engagement

• Reply to comments and DMs warmly and on-brand, and flag anything that needs my personal attention

• Engage with fans' posts, tags and shares to build community

• Help support my street team of fans who promote shows

Community growth

• Share music and content to relevant Reddit communities, following each subreddit's rules

• Find and join fan groups and online communities (music, gaming, animation, fantasy/mythology) and participate genuinely, not spammily

• Keep a running list of communities, what's worked and what hasn't



Design and website

• Create show flyers, release graphics and social assets in Canva using my brand templates and fonts

• Make simple updates to my website (show dates, new releases, links, bio tweaks)

Reporting

• Track basic performance (follower growth, top posts, engagement) and bring a short summary to our weekly meeting



What I'm looking for

Required

• Excellent written and spoken English, with a natural, friendly tone (you'll be speaking to fans as part of my brand)

• Strong, proactive communication: you ask questions early, give updates without being chased, and flag problems quickly

• 1+ year managing social media for a brand, creator or business (Instagram, TikTok and YouTube)

• Comfortable with Canva and Notion

• Familiarity with Reddit culture and etiquette

• Reliable internet, your own computer, and availability for a weekly video call during US Pacific hours

• Discretion and good judgment when posting publicly on someone else's behalf

Nice to have

• A genuine love of video games and/or animation (anime, cartoons, fantasy) and knowing where those fans gather online

• Interest in indie, folk or singer-songwriter music

• Experience with website builders (e.g. Squarespace, Wix, WordPress)

• Basic video editing or experience with CapCut

• Experience growing a music artist's or creator's following



Hours

Starting around 10 hours per week, with potential room to grow as we find our rhythm

Schedule

Flexible; some daily check-ins for comments and DMs are expected

Meetings

One weekly video call (about an hour during US Pacific hours



Start date

ASAP

The role begins with a paid trial period of 3 weeks  so we can both make sure it's a good fit.



How to apply

Send the following to 
 / platform]:

1.  A short intro about yourself and your social media experience

2.  Links to 2–3 accounts you've managed or grown, with a sentence on your role in each

3.  Your favorite video game or animated show, and one online community where its fans gather

4.  Your hourly rate and weekly availability

5.  Short task: Imagine you're promoting my upcoming show at the Hotel Cafe in Hollywood. Write an Instagram caption for it, and a friendly reply to a fan who comments "Wish I could be there!"

Please include the word "Wonderland" in your subject line so I know you read the full posting.

Shortlisted applicants will be invited to a short video interview and may be asked to create a sample Canva graphic.

title: Medical Billing and Collections Specialist
description:
We are a a physician-owned medical practice in Plantation, Florida, seeking an experienced, organized, and motivated Medical Billing & Patient Collections Specialist to help manage outstanding patient balances and improve our revenue cycle.

We are looking for someone who is comfortable speaking with patients about financial responsibilities, understands medical billing and insurance payments, and can independently follow up on outstanding accounts.

This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced medical billing professional seeking flexible, part-time hours in a small, professional medical practice.

Key Responsibilities

Review patient accounts receivable (A/R) and identify outstanding patient balances.

Contact patients by telephone to discuss balances and arrange payment.

Follow up on overdue accounts, unpaid statements, and outstanding payment arrangements.

Review insurance explanations of benefits (EOBs) to verify patient financial responsibility.

Identify billing errors, incorrect balances, and accounts requiring adjustments.

Offer approved payment plans and prompt-pay discounts when appropriate.

Process payments and accurately document collection activity.

Coordinate with our billing team to resolve disputed or incorrectly billed accounts.

Maintain organized records of collection efforts and patient communications.

Prepare a brief weekly report detailing collections, outstanding balances, and account follow-up.

Assist with other medical billing and administrative responsibilities as needed.

Qualifications

Required:

At least 2 years of experience in medical billing, patient collections, or healthcare accounts receivable.

Familiarity with insurance EOBs, patient responsibility, deductibles, and coinsurance.

Comfortable making outbound patient collection calls.

Strong communication skills and a professional, compassionate approach to patient interactions.

Ability to work independently, prioritize accounts, and follow through on outstanding balances.

Basic computer skills and experience with electronic medical records or practice management systems.

Preferred:

Experience with Tebra/Kareo practice management software.

Experience in a private physician practice.

Familiarity with Medicare and commercial insurance billing.

Experience managing aged patient A/R and payment arrangements.



Compensation & Benefits

$5-7/Hour

Initially a part time, with option to extend to full time based on performance.

Supportive, physician-owned practice environment.

Opportunity for additional responsibilities and hours as the practice grows.



Ideal Candidate

Our ideal candidate is someone who takes ownership of outstanding accounts, follows through consistently, and understands that effective patient collections require both persistence and empathy.

We value someone who is detail-oriented, reliable, and comfortable working independently without constant supervision.



How to Apply

Please submit your resume through Indeed, highlighting your experience with medical billing, patient collections, accounts receivable, and any practice management software you have used.

Candidates with direct experience collecting outstanding patient balances in a medical practice are strongly encouraged to apply.

title: Documentary Video Editor
description:
We are looking for a skilled video editor who can create high-quality, cinematic documentary-style videos for our YouTube channel.



We want videos with a polished, engaging storytelling style similar to premium streaming documentaries, with carefully selected visuals, smooth transitions, sound design, background music, and motion graphics that support the story.



Responsibilities



-Edit long-form YouTube videos with a cinematic documentary feel.

-Select relevant news footage, archival clips, article images, and other visuals to match the narration.

-Use smooth transitions, subtle motion graphics, and effects where appropriate.

-Add sound effects and background music to enhance the storytelling.

-Ensure clear voice-over audio and balanced sound levels.

-Maintain a strong pace that keeps viewers engaged throughout the video.

-Follow our editing guidelines, scripts, and reference videos.



Requirements



-Experience editing documentary-style or storytelling-focused YouTube videos.

-Strong sense of storytelling, pacing, and visual presentation.

-Ability to find relevant footage that matches the narration.

-Good audio editing and sound design skills.

-Reliable communication and ability to follow instructions.

-Willingness to receive feedback and make revisions when needed.



Project Details

title: Shopify & AI Solutions Developer
description:
The FSW Group (ValveMan, FS Welsford, and our growing family of companies) 



Full-time | Remote, Philippines-based | 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM Eastern Time 



Apply through this link only: 

 

Who We Are 



We are a family business, and we mean that in every sense of the word. The FSW Group is a collection of companies, including ValveMan and Welsford Co., built over decades on relationships, trust, and a belief that how you treat people matters just as much as what you build. We are not a faceless corporation, and we are not looking to fill a seat. We are looking for someone to grow with us for years to come. 

 

When we say we treat our team like family, we are telling you what we expect of ourselves as much as what we offer you. We care about the people who build alongside us. We celebrate wins together, we work through challenges together, and we are genuinely invested in helping every team member build a career they are proud of. This is a long-term opportunity, not a gig. If you are someone who wants to keep sharpening your skills, take on bigger challenges over time, and build something meaningful with a company that has your back, we would love to meet you. 

 

The Role in a Nutshell 



We are looking for a self-driven senior developer to become the engine behind how we use AI to improve our businesses. You will use Claude, Claude Code, Codex, and whatever is the best tool for the job at that time.  



You will work on page and app development on the Shopify store by using existing applications or developing your own solutions. All frontend development on Shopify must be done with AEO, SEO, CWV, UI and UX in mind. Any development must be done so to FSW Group standards and monitored and maintained in the long run as well. You will own projects from the very first conversation all the way through to a working, deployed solution that people across our organization actually use each and every day. Post deployment, you will train team members on how to use the tool and continue to monitor the tool to assure it works.  

 

This is not a build-it-and-hand-it-off role. You will take an idea or an opportunity that may start out fuzzy, shape it into a clear plan, confirm it with the right people, build it, and then get it live and running. You are the owner from start to finish and beyond. 

 

The work is broad. Some projects will be classic software and web development. Others will be about streamlining how a part of the business runs, setting up automations and triggers, or building reporting and dashboards. Many will touch Epicor Profit21 and the wider Microsoft ecosystem, such as Power Automate and Power BI. The common thread is that you are improving how the FSW Group operates, and you are using the best AI tools available to do it. 

 

What You Will Actually Do 



- Take ownership of two to three projects at a time across the FSW Group, keeping your focus where it matters most without getting pulled in too many directions at once. 

- Keep track of and manage the pipeline of project requests 

- Understand the full picture of the projects on our plate, and gather complete, well-organized requirements for each one. 

- Turn those requirements into a clear Statement of Work that everyone can agree on. 

- Validate the requirements and the plan with the designated business leader, which 

depending on the project may be the leader of Welsford Co, the leader of ValveMan, or the CEO of the Group. 

- Build the solution, using Claude,Claude Code, or the best tool/set of tools for that application. 

- Deploy it. Getting something working as an MVPis only half the job. You are responsible for taking it all the way into a live, operational system that actually works in the real world. 

- Work across whatever platforms the project requires, which may include our ecommerce systems, internal web applications, cloud infrastructure, automation tools, and Epicor Profit21, plus Microsoft tools like Power Automate and Power BI where they fit. 

- Improve processes, not just code. Some of your work will be about rethinking how a workflow runs, adding the right triggers, and finding optimizations that touch any part of the organization. 

- Keep an eye out for new opportunities. As you come to understand how things flow across our businesses, we want you to surface ideas for additional improvements we have not even thought to ask for yet. This is a secondary part of the role, but a valued one. 

 

Who You Are 



- A genuinely strong developer with real experience architecting webapps as well as building and shipping software. 

- Experienced with vibe coding (Claude Code, Codex, etc) specifically, and comfortable making AI tools the center of how you work. 

- Someone with a real track record of architecting and deploying applications, not just prototyping them. 

- You know the difference between “it runs on my machine” and “it is live and people depend on it.” 

- You keep clear repos for handoffs and long term sustainability Capable of taking an ambiguous opportunity and running with it on your own. You can manage the whole pipeline, from requirements to delivery, without needing to be handed every step. 

- Comfortable with Epicor Profit21, or confident you can get there quickly. 

- A clear communicator who can talk to business leaders, understand what they actually need, and keep everyone aligned. 

- Organized enough to juggle a few projects at once while keeping organized and focused on a quality high output. 

- Excited to keep learning. This role will keep evolving, and we want someone who is eager to evolve with it. 

 

What You'll Work With 



- Front-end: React / TypeScript preferred (other frameworks welcome) 

- 
 preferred (other languages welcome) 

- E-commerce: Shopify 

- AI-assisted development: Day-to-day coding with Claude Code 

- AI & Automation: Building AI automation with Claude and working with Large Language Models (LLMs) 

- QA & Testing: Automated testing with Claude, plus automated smoke tests using Claude or Grok 

- Cloud: Azure, Azure Container Apps 

- Database: Azure Database for PostgreSQL 

- DevOps: Azure DevOps (Repos & Pipelines) for CI/CD 

 

Requirements 



Required 

- Hands-on full-stack experience, front-end to back-end 

- Strong knowledge of Shopify 

- Experience with, or a strong interest in, LLMs and Claude-based AI automation 

- Open to AI-assisted coding workflows 

- Good spoken English communication skills 



Nice to Have 

- React / TypeScript 
 experience 

- Experience deploying and running apps on Azure, including Azure Container Apps and Azure Database for PostgreSQL 

Azure DevOps (Repos & Pipelines) and CI/CD experience 

- Familiarity with automated testing and QA workflows, including smoke tests with Claude or Grok 

- Knowledge of Power BI and Power Automate 

 

How We Work Together 



You will report to our Virtual Team Manager, who will help you prioritize, protect your focus, and make sure you have what you need to do great work. Your day-to-day business leader will vary by project, but you will always have a clear point of contact and clear direction on what success looks like. 

 

The Schedule 



This is a full-time role of 40 hours per week, working 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM Eastern Time (1 hour lunch break) so that you are fully aligned with our US team’s time. Forty hours is also the cap, because we believe in protecting your time and your energy. We are a family-first company, and that means we want you doing your best work during the day and then living your life when the day is done. 

 

The Trial Project 



Before we both fully commit, we will start with one real-world project together. It will be a small to medium sized project, the kind of work you would actually be doing in the role, and it will run from start to finish in roughly one week. You will own it the same way you would own anything else: gather the requirements, validate them, build it in Claude Code, and deploy it into a working system with proper documentation. This gives you a real feel for the work and our culture, and it gives us a chance to see your skills in action. This assures that the role/responsibilities will work for both parties moving forward.  

 

What We Offer 



A long-term home, not a short-term contract. We are looking for someone to build their career with us. 

A team that genuinely cares about you and treats you like family. 

The chance to work with cutting-edge AI tools every single day, and to keep growing your skills as the role expands. 

After six months of employment, as long as you are meeting all requirements of the role, you will receive five days of paid time off along with a stipend toward your HMO health insurance. 

Real ownership and real impact. Your work will directly improve how our companies run. 

 

Our Core Values 



These are not words on a wall. They are how we operate, and they are what we will look for in you. 

Integrity. Do what is right. Do what you say. 

Ambition. Continually level up. We want people who are always reaching for the next thing. 

Entrepreneurial Spirit. Take initiative, think like an owner, and find the better way. 

Supportive. Win together. Grow together. 

 

How to Apply 



We are not in a rush, and we say that on purpose. More than anything, we want the right person, someone who is a great fit for our culture and brings the skills this role demands. If you are available to start soon, wonderful. If the timing needs to be a little further out for the right candidate, that is completely fine too. 

 

If this sounds like the kind of work and the kind of team you have been looking for, we would love to hear from you. Tell us about yourself, share your experience with development and with vibe coded projects, and show us something you have built and deployed. We read every application, and we look forward to getting to know you.

About Us



Maison Emerald is a Dubai-based luxury travel, events and lifestyle advisory serving an international clientele. We specialise in highly personalised travel arrangements, luxury hotels, complex itineraries and exceptional client experiences.

Air Reservations & Sabre GDS

Confidently handle multi-city journeys, mixed cabins, multiple airlines, codeshares and complicated routings.



Interpret fare rules, restrictions, baggage allowances, ticket conditions and cancellation penalties.



Calculate fare differences, taxes, penalties and additional collections for flight amendments and reissues.



Manage PNRs, schedule changes, cancellations, refunds, exchanges and airline servicing requests.



Identify alternative routings, fare combinations and cost-saving opportunities.



Coordinate ticket issuance and servicing with our authorised ticketing partners.



Resolve complex reservation issues independently, accurately and efficiently.



Hotel Reservations & Travel Operations



Research, compare and reserve luxury hotels and resorts worldwide.



Check availability, pricing, room categories, cancellation policies and inclusions across multiple booking channels.



Compare direct hotel rates, preferred partner programmes, wholesale rates and other booking platforms to identify the best commercial options.



Communicate directly with hotels, suppliers and reservations departments.



Manage booking amendments, cancellations, confirmations and special requests.



Maintain accurate reservation records, supplier documentation and payment information.



Support the wider team with itinerary preparation, quotations and ongoing travel arrangements.



Essential Requirements



Minimum 3–5 years of professional experience in travel reservations, air ticketing or travel agency operations.



Advanced, practical Sabre GDS proficiency is mandatory.



Proven ability to independently fare complex international itineraries without supervision.



Strong working knowledge of airline fare rules, ticket reissues, refunds, exchanges and schedule changes.



Previous experience booking and managing international hotel reservations.



Excellent understanding of travel pricing, supplier rates and reservation processes.



Strong attention to detail, particularly with financial calculations, passenger information and ticketing deadlines.



Excellent written and spoken English.



Comfortable managing multiple bookings, urgent changes and competing priorities.



Able to work independently in a remote environment.



Experience with luxury travel agencies, premium cabin reservations, international clientele and additional travel booking systems will be highly advantageous.



What We're Looking For



We need someone who genuinely understands travel reservations from start to finish.



You should be able to receive a complicated flight request, identify the most suitable routing, calculate an accurate fare, explain the applicable conditions and confidently manage subsequent amendments.



Likewise, you should be comfortable independently checking hotel options, comparing rates and ensuring every reservation is accurate.



We are not looking for a general virtual assistant, someone with basic Sabre familiarity or a candidate who has only completed GDS training without substantial real-world experience.



How to Apply



Please include the following in your application:



Your CV and details of your previous travel agency, airline or reservations experience.



How many years you have actively used Sabre in a professional environment.



An example of a complex flight itinerary you have independently priced or managed, including any changes or reissues.



Details of your hotel reservation experience and booking platforms used.



Your expected monthly salary in PHP and availability to start.



Important: Begin your application with the words "SABRE SPECIALIST" so we know you have read and understood the requirements.

title: Social Media, Content & Community Growth Specialist
description:
# Social Media Content & Community Growth Specialist | Organic Growth & Content Creation



**Location:** Remote – Philippines  

**Type:** Full-Time | Long-Term Opportunity  

**Schedule:** Monday–Friday, 2:00 PM–12:00 AM Philippine Time 



## About Us



Expressionable is a growing U.S.-based digital healthcare company managing multiple online health and wellness brands.



We're looking for a creative, proactive, and results-driven **Social Media Content & Community Growth Specialist** who loves creating engaging content, building communities, and growing social media audiences.



**We're not looking for someone who simply schedules posts and maintains social media accounts.**



We want someone who understands how to attract new followers, create content people genuinely want to engage with, build meaningful community relationships, and continuously find opportunities for organic growth.



If you're someone who gets excited about growing an Instagram account, experimenting with new content strategies, identifying trending topics, and turning a small audience into an engaged community, we'd love to meet you!



## What You'll Be Doing



**1. Organic Follower & Community Growth**



- Develop and execute creative strategies to consistently grow our social media followers organically.

- Identify opportunities to attract new audiences through engaging content, trending topics, and strategic community participation.

- Proactively engage with relevant accounts, creators, and communities to build brand awareness and attract genuine followers.

- Explore collaborations, community partnerships, and other creative growth opportunities.

- Monitor competitors and successful accounts to discover strategies we can learn from and adapt.

- Experiment with different approaches to determine what generates the most meaningful growth.



**2. Social Media Content Creation**



- Create engaging content for Instagram,
, TikTok, and other relevant social media platforms.

- Develop Reels, short-form videos, carousels, graphics, stories, and educational content.

- Write compelling captions, attention-grabbing hooks, and engaging calls to action.

- Use tools like Canva, CapCut, ChatGPT, and other AI-powered tools to produce quality content efficiently.

- Repurpose successful content across multiple platforms while adapting it for each audience.

- Stay current with social media trends, formats, and platform best practices.



**3. Community Engagement & Management**



- Actively engage with followers through comments, messages, and community discussions.

- Identify conversations and communities where our brands can contribute value and increase visibility.

- Encourage meaningful interactions that build trust and long-term relationships.

- Help create an active, welcoming community around our brands.

- Monitor audience feedback and identify opportunities to improve engagement.

- Maintain professionalism, sensitivity, and brand accuracy when communicating about healthcare topics.



**4. Social Media Strategy & Performance**



- Maintain and execute an organized social media content calendar.

- Track follower growth, engagement, organic reach, shares, saves, and other relevant performance metrics.

- Identify which content performs best and explain why.

- Recommend new content ideas and growth experiments based on real performance data.

- Share regular progress reports with the Marketing Manager.

- Continuously improve our social media strategy based on results.



## What We're Looking For



- Proven experience managing and **organically growing social media accounts**.

- Strong content creation skills, including graphics and short-form video editing.

- Understanding of Instagram,
, TikTok, and current social media trends.

- Experience building engaged communities, not just accumulating followers.

- Ability to explain and demonstrate specific strategies you've used to achieve growth.

- Strong written and spoken English communication skills.

- Comfortable using AI tools to improve creativity, productivity, and workflow.

- Highly organized, self-motivated, and capable of managing multiple brands.

- Creative thinker who proactively suggests new ideas rather than waiting for instructions.

- Comfortable analyzing performance metrics and taking accountability for results.



**Bonus Skills**



- Experience with U.S.-based brands or audiences.

- Experience in healthcare, wellness, beauty, or lifestyle marketing.

- Influencer outreach and creator collaboration experience.

- Familiarity with Meta Business Suite and social media analytics tools.

- Experience creating content that generates substantial organic reach.

- Understanding of social media platform algorithms and content optimization.



## What Success Looks Like



We want someone who takes ownership of our social media growth.



Success in this role means:



- Consistently increasing genuine, relevant followers across our social channels.

- Creating content that attracts attention, generates shares, and encourages engagement.

- Building communities where people actively interact with our brands.

- Bringing fresh ideas and testing creative strategies for growth.

- Demonstrating measurable progress and continuously improving results.



**We value quality followers and authentic engagement over vanity metrics.** Buying followers, using bots, or engaging in artificial growth tactics is not acceptable.



## What We Offer



- Long-term opportunity with a growing U.S.-based company.

- Competitive compensation based on experience and agreed working hours.

- Payments twice per month through Wise.

- 12 paid days off annually.

- Supportive, collaborative marketing team.

- Opportunity to work with multiple growing brands.

- Exposure to modern marketing tools, AI, and creative technology.

- Opportunities for professional growth and greater responsibility.



## How to Apply — PLEASE READ CAREFULLY



We want to get to know you, understand your experience, and see how you approach growing social media accounts.



**To be considered, you MUST submit all THREE items below.**



**1. Your Resume**



Please share your updated resume highlighting your social media management, content creation, and audience growth experience.



**2. Portfolio & Examples of Your Work**



Provide links to social media accounts you've managed, content you've created, or campaigns you've worked on.



We'd especially love to see:



- Social media accounts you've helped grow.

- Before-and-after follower counts, including the timeframe.

- Examples of successful Reels, videos, carousels, or other content.

- Screenshots of growth or engagement results, if available.

- A brief explanation of your personal contributions to those results.



**3. REQUIRED: Video Introduction (2–4 Minutes)**



Please record a short video introducing yourself and answering the following questions:



**A. Tell us about yourself.**  

Briefly introduce yourself and explain your experience with social media content creation and community growth.



**B. How do you grow followers organically?**  

Walk us through your actual process. How do you attract new followers, improve reach, and get more people engaging with an account?



**C. Share a real example.**  

Tell us about an account you helped grow. What was the starting follower count? What did it grow to? How long did it take? What specifically did you do to achieve those results?



**D. What would you do for us?**  

Imagine you're taking over a healthcare brand's social media account with a small audience. What would your first 30 days look like to start building followers and community engagement?



You can record your video using Loom, Google Drive, or another video-sharing platform. Please make sure the link is accessible.



No fancy editing or production is necessary. We simply want to hear you explain your experience, creativity, and thought process.



Please include:



1. Resume

2. Portfolio/work examples, including growth results

3. Video introduction link



**Applications without a video introduction will be considered incomplete and will not be reviewed or receive a response.**



We're looking for someone who genuinely enjoys social media, understands audience growth, and wants to build something meaningful with our team.



If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you!

title: HighLevel Automation & Implementation Specialist (US Time Zone)
description:
ABOUT US:

Our company helps associations and membership organizations create better member experiences through modern websites, automation, and connected systems. Every client implementation is different. Some require large data migrations, others involve building searchable member directories, connecting software platforms, or improving existing client systems. We're looking for someone who enjoys figuring out how software works and takes pride in building clean, reliable solutions behind the scenes.



We're looking for a talented HighLevel Automation & Implementation Specialist who enjoys solving problems, building smart automations, and figuring out creative ways to make technology work.



This isn't an entry-level position, but you don't need to be a senior developer either. We're looking for someone with solid hands-on HighLevel experience who can work independently, follow specifications, and take pride in building creative solutions to complex operational challenges.



WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING:



You'll work with our implementation team to configure and customize HighLevel accounts for a variety of membership organizations.



Your responsibilities will include:



Building Automations: Create and troubleshoot HighLevel workflows for membership renewals, onboarding, payments, notifications, and other business processes.



Customizing Accounts: Configure custom fields, custom objects, forms, surveys, pipelines, memberships, and other HighLevel features based on client requirements.



Exploring AI Solutions: Use HighLevel's AI capabilities, including AI Studio, AI Portal, and Ask AI, to help create new solutions and improve existing processes.



Solving Problems: Figure out how to accomplish client requests, including situations where HighLevel doesn't have an obvious out-of-the-box solution.



Connecting Systems: Work with webhooks, APIs, Make, Zapier, or other integration tools when needed.



Testing Your Work: Thoroughly test automations, configurations, and other builds to ensure everything works as intended before handing them off.



Documenting Builds: Keep clear records of how things are configured so other team members can understand and support your work.



Improving Processes: Help identify ways to make our implementations more efficient, consistent, and reliable.





REQUIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE:



- At least 2 years of hands-on experience working with HighLevel (GoHighLevel).

- Experience configuring and customizing multiple HighLevel accounts, preferably in an agency environment.

- Strong understanding of workflows, triggers, conditional logic, custom fields, forms, and account configuration.

- Ability to build and troubleshoot complex automations independently.

- Experience with custom objects and building object associations

- Experience with data imports and migrations into HighLevel

- Strong attention to detail and a commitment to testing your work thoroughly.

- Good written English communication skills.

- Resourceful, organized, and comfortable learning new technology.



Bonus Skills (Not Required, but Awesome if You Do)

Experience with HighLevel AI Studio, AI Portal, Ask AI, or other AI development tools.

Experience with APIs, webhooks, Make, or Zapier.

Familiarity with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, or AI-assisted coding.





THE KIND OF PERSON WHO WILL THRIVE HERE:



- Loves figuring things out. When something isn't straightforward, you investigate, experiment, and find a solution.

- Pays attention to details. You don't just build something and assume it works. You test it and make sure it's right.

- Takes ownership. You can manage your assigned work without needing constant reminders or supervision.

- Asks good questions. You recognize when something is unclear and seek clarification before building the wrong thing.

- Enjoys variety. Every client has different needs, and you like the challenge of creating customized solutions.

- Embraces new technology. You're interested in AI and excited about learning new ways to accomplish things.

- Works well with a team. You communicate clearly, share what you've learned, and help others succeed.



This isn't a job where you'll spend every day copying funnels or building the same basic workflows. Our clients have unique needs, which means you'll have opportunities to work on interesting projects and develop creative solutions using HighLevel.



One day you might build a membership renewal automation. The next, you could configure a custom directory, automate an application process, or help develop a new AI-powered tool.



We're a friendly, collaborative team that values initiative, problem-solving, continuous learning, and taking exceptional care of our clients.



We want someone who enjoys the work, takes pride in doing it well, and wants to grow their skills alongside our company.



SCHEDULE:

This is a full-time remote position with a targeted schedule of 8 am - 4 pm in US Central Business Hours, but flexibility is available if your hours need to vary slightly from that.



HOW TO APPLY:

Please answer the following questions when submitting your application:



HighLevel Experience: How long have you worked with HighLevel? Have you worked with multiple client accounts? Approximately how many?



Your Most Complex Automation: Describe one of the most challenging HighLevel workflows or customized solutions you've built. What did it do, and what made it challenging?



Troubleshooting: Tell us about a time something wasn't working correctly in HighLevel. How did you figure out what was wrong and fix it?



AI Experience: Have you used HighLevel AI Studio, AI Portal, Ask AI, or other AI development tools? If so, what have you created?



Work Samples: If possible, share a short Loom video, screenshots, or examples of your HighLevel work. Please do not share confidential client information.



Please include the word "Journey" in the subject line of your application so we know you've read the posting carefully.



We're especially interested in applicants who have worked across multiple HighLevel accounts, enjoy solving challenging problems, and take pride in delivering accurate, reliable work.



We look forward to hearing from you!

title: B2B Cold Caller & Sales Closer — Part-Time
description:
B2B Cold Caller & Sales Closer (Part-Time, Remote)



Company: Datkov Studio  

Location: Remote — Philippines  

Hours: 20 hours per week  

Compensation: ₱35,000 monthly base + 15% sales commission  

Payment Schedule: Fortnightly  

Initial Arrangement: 2-week paid trial, with the opportunity for ongoing part-time work



ABOUT DATKOV STUDIO:

Datkov Studio is an Australian commercial creative studio producing professional visual content for consumer-product brands.



We create product imagery, lifestyle visuals, advertising creatives and short-form videos that businesses can use across their websites, social media, product launches and marketing campaigns.



Our services are completely done-for-you, from creative direction through to final delivery.



We're a growing, founder-led studio looking for an experienced salesperson to help us acquire clients across Australia, the United Kingdom and the United States.



ABOUT THE ROLE:

We're looking for a confident and experienced B2B cold caller who can independently manage sales conversations and close deals.



Your primary responsibility will be contacting businesses from qualified lead lists provided by Datkov Studio, introducing our services, identifying potential opportunities and converting interested prospects into paying clients.



This is not an appointment-setting-only position. We're looking for someone capable of handling the full sales process, from the initial phone call through to closing.



You will not be responsible for researching businesses, sourcing phone numbers or generating lead lists. All leads and contact information will be provided.



YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES:

- Make outbound cold calls to business leads provided by Datkov Studio.

- Speak professionally with business owners, founders and marketing decision-makers.

- Introduce our commercial creative services and explain how they can benefit potential customers.

- Identify customer needs, marketing objectives and potential opportunities.

- Handle questions, objections and sales conversations confidently.

- Conduct discovery and sales meetings when necessary.

- Recommend appropriate creative packages based on customer requirements.

- Follow up with interested prospects and maintain professional relationships.

- Close sales and guide customers through our official payment process.

- Record call outcomes, prospect information and follow-up activities in our Notion CRM.

- Provide clear project handovers to the studio once a client has paid.

- Provide regular updates on sales activity and progress.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR:



Required:



- Previous experience in B2B cold calling and outbound sales.

- Demonstrated experience closing deals, rather than only booking appointments.

- Excellent spoken and written English.

- Confidence speaking with international business owners and decision-makers.

- Strong communication, listening and objection-handling skills.

- Ability to communicate professionally without relying entirely on scripts.

- Comfortable conducting sales conversations over the phone and through online meetings.

- Good organisational skills and the ability to manage follow-ups independently.

- Reliable internet connection and a quiet environment suitable for professional calls.



Preferred:



- Experience selling creative, design, advertising or marketing services.

- Experience working with Australian, British or American clients.

- Familiarity with CRM software.

- Experience working remotely with small businesses or agencies.



You do not need previous experience with AI image or video production. We will provide information and training on our creative services, portfolio, packages and production process.



WHAT WE PROVIDE:

- Qualified business leads and phone numbers.

- Access to an international business calling platform.

- A Notion CRM for managing prospects and sales activity.

- A detailed sales playbook explaining our services, positioning, packages and sales process.

- Portfolio examples and approved sales materials.

- Direct communication with the studio founder.

- Guidance on creative capabilities, deliverables and pricing.



You will be responsible for selling our services, not producing the creative content.



COMPENSATION AND WORKING ARRANGEMENT:

- ₱35,000 monthly base compensation for 20 hours of work per week.

- 15% commission on eligible sales successfully closed and paid.

- Base compensation paid fortnightly.

- A paid two-week trial consisting of 20 total hours, with the applicable commission on eligible sales.

- Flexible working hours, with agreed availability during suitable calling periods for our target markets.

- Fully remote working arrangement.

- Opportunity for an ongoing part-time role following a successful trial.

- Compensation review after the initial three months, subject to performance and business circumstances.



Commission eligibility, payment timing, working arrangements and other terms will be clearly defined in a written agreement before work begins.



THE TWO-WEEK PAID TRIAL:

Selected candidates will complete a paid two-week (20 hours total) trial before an ongoing arrangement is offered.



During this period, you will:

- Learn about Datkov Studio's services, packages and portfolio.

- Review our sales playbook and familiarise yourself with our CRM.

- Demonstrate your ability to pitch our services professionally.

- Begin contacting qualified business leads provided by the studio.

- Handle prospect conversations, objections and follow-ups.

- Maintain accurate records of your sales activity.

- Demonstrate independence, professionalism and effective communication.



The trial will be evaluated based on communication, calling quality, sales ability, professionalism, reliability and the ability to advance genuine opportunities.



Closing a sale during the trial is welcome but is not a strict requirement for passing.



HOW TO APPLY:

Please include the following in your application:



1. A brief introduction and summary of your previous sales experience.



2. Details of your B2B cold-calling experience, including the types of products or services you've sold.



3. An example of a deal you personally closed. Explain how you approached the prospect and secured the sale.



4. Whether you have experience speaking with Australian, UK or US businesses.



5. A 60–90-second voice introduction demonstrating your spoken English and explaining why you're interested in this role.



6. Your availability and preferred working schedule.



Please also answer this question:



"Imagine you're calling the owner of a skincare brand. How would you introduce Datkov Studio's commercial creative services and create interest in a potential project?"



We're particularly interested in candidates who understand how to communicate business value, build genuine relationships and close deals professionally.



ABOUT WORKING WITH US:

Datkov Studio is a growing creative business. This is an opportunity to work directly with the founder and play an important role in developing our client base.



We value clear communication, honesty, initiative, professionalism and a respectful working relationship.



We're looking for someone who can bring genuine sales expertise, take ownership of their conversations and grow alongside the studio as the business develops.



We look forward to hearing from you.
